library_entry.summary: The Moon's ten-year mahadasha is described as a generally pleasant period: peace of mind, comfort, good food, gains of clothes, ornaments, land and cattle, marriage or children, and favour from those in authority. All sources make the outcome depend on the Moon's strength. A strong, waxing or well-placed Moon gives the full good results. A debilitated, waning, afflicted or 6th/8th/12th-house Moon brings loss of money, worry, trouble to the mother and friction with authorities.
common_outcomes: opulence, good fortune, gain of wealth, auspicious functions at home, high position, vehicles, clothes, children and cattle when the Moon is strong and well placed (BPHS 47.16-22)
tranquillity of mind, success in all business, good food, wife and children, ornaments, clothes, gems, cows and lands; honouring Brahmins (Phaladeepika 19.7)
money through sacred prayers, deities, Brahmins and royal favour; women, wealth and lands; flowers, clothes, ornaments and perfumes (Phaladeepika 19.19; Jataka Parijata 18.73)
misunderstandings with wicked people, some loss of money, wind-related illness (Phaladeepika 19.19)
loss of wealth when the Moon is debilitated or waning (BPHS 47.23-26)
rare_outcomes: extraordinary wealth and luxuries when the strong Moon is in the 2nd house (BPHS 47.16-22)
gain of a deposit or hidden treasure and acquisition of learning, with the Moon in the 2nd (BPHS 47.21-22, Sanskrit gloss)
digging tanks and building gardens or public works (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI, tr. P.S. Sastri, p. 144)
unexpected finding of treasure (Raman, Moon in Cancer)
death of the mother (Raman, Moon in Virgo)

by_area.personality: Calm and contented mind when the Moon is strong (Phaladeepika 19.7). With malefics: dullness, mental tension (BPHS 47.23-26); irritability (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI). Waning or descending Moon: mental worry and derangement (Raman).
by_area.career: High position in government, recognition from rulers, success in undertakings (BPHS 47.16-22); success in all business (Phaladeepika 19.7); taking charge of a new office (Raman, Moon in Pisces). Inimical relations with government when a waning Moon is in the 6th, 8th or 12th or with malefics (BPHS 47.23-26); trouble from employees (BPHS 47.23-26).
by_area.finance: Gain of wealth, vehicles, clothes, cattle and land (BPHS 47.16-22; Phaladeepika 19.7, 19.19); wealth that keeps increasing when the Moon is strong (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI). Loss of wealth if the Moon is debilitated, waning or with malefics (BPHS 47.23-26); want of food and loss of money if the Moon is malefic (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI); poverty if anything checks the Moon's strength (Jataka Parijata 18.73).
by_area.health: Good health when the Moon is strong. Wind-related disease (Phaladeepika 19.19; Jataka Parijata 18.73); ill health and fevers when the Moon is malefic (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI); bodily sluggishness with a weak Moon joined by malefics (BPHS 47.24, Sanskrit gloss).
by_area.relationships: Acquisition of a wife, children and the company of women (Phaladeepika 19.7, 19.19); births of children (BPHS 47.16-22). Troubles to the wife when the Moon is descending from exaltation (Raman).
by_area.family: Auspicious functions at home (BPHS 47.16-22); well-being of the mother when the Moon is strong (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI). Distress to the mother when the Moon is waning, weak or with malefics (BPHS 47.23-26). Quarrels with relatives when the Moon is weak (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI); domestic happiness with the Moon in Sagittarius (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and Brahmins, sacred prayers and recitation (Phaladeepika 19.7, 19.19; Jataka Parijata 18.73); visits to holy places with the Moon in Libra or Capricorn and reciting religious texts with the Moon in Pisces (Raman).

strengtheners: Moon exalted (Taurus) or in its own sign (BPHS 47.16-22)
Moon in a kendra or in the 5th, 9th or 11th (BPHS 47.16-22)
Moon joined or aspected by benefics, or full (waxing) and strong (BPHS 47.17, Sanskrit gloss)
Moon associated with the lords of the 9th, 10th or 4th (BPHS 47.16-22)
Moon in the 2nd house, especially in exaltation or its own sign (BPHS 47.21-22)
Moon full in the middle ten days of the lunar month (Phaladeepika 19.8)
Moon owning the 8th house does not spoil the period: the Sun and the Moon give good results even as 8th lords (Phaladeepika 20.41)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon debilitated (Scorpio) or waning (BPHS 47.23)
Moon associated with malefics (BPHS 47.24)
waning Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with malefics (BPHS 47.25)
Moon in the last ten days of the lunar month: effects decline gradually (Phaladeepika 19.8)
anything that checks the Moon's strength (Jataka Parijata 18.73)
a natural benefic in debilitation, an enemy's sign or the 6th or 12th gives only untoward results (Phaladeepika 20.27, general rule)
kendra lordship spoils natural benefics; the Moon's blemish is ranked after Jupiter, Venus and Mercury (Phaladeepika 20.50-51)
library_entry.phases: Jataka Parijata 18.83: at the start of the Moon's period come the results of the house the Moon rules over; in the middle, results from the nature of that sign and the Moon's own position; towards the end, results from the planets aspecting the Moon and to the part of the body that house governs. Phaladeepika 20.33 (general rule): a planet in a shirshodaya sign gives its results early in its period, in an ubhayodaya sign in the middle, and in a prishtodaya sign at the end. Frawley (pp. 202-203, general): a benefic period gives seeds at its start and fruit later.
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS and Uttara Kalamrita make the whole period good or bad by the Moon's strength and placement. Phaladeepika 19.19 and Jataka Parijata 18.73 give fixed mixed results: comforts together with some loss of money and wind disease. Santhanam reads BPHS 47 as one long list of favourable conditions; the Sanskrit gloss splits it and reads verse 19 as the Moon in the 4th, a placement Santhanam does not mention. In BPHS 47.23 Santhanam gives the Moon in the 3rd 'happiness off and on'; the gloss says a strong Moon there brings wealth and happiness intermittently. Raman's sign results (bad in Virgo and Aquarius, good in Libra and Capricorn) are not found in the BPHS or Phaladeepika chapters read. Phaladeepika 20.41 exempts the Moon from the 8th-lord blemish but 20.50-51 still counts its kendra lordship as a mild blemish.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Describe this as a period whose tone follows the Moon's condition: comfort, home life and emotional steadiness when the Moon is strong; worry, money strain and concern for the mother when it is weak. Say waxing or waning plainly, as a matter of strength. Do not predict the mother's death or any illness as certain; frame health points as times to rest and look after the body.

library_entry.summary: Mars's seven-year mahadasha is a period of energy, effort and conflict: income through land, courage, authority, fighting, medicine or fire, alongside quarrels with siblings and family and illness from heat, bile and blood. BPHS makes it strongly favourable (high position, land, wealth, victory over enemies) when Mars is exalted, in its own or moolatrikona sign, or strong in a kendra, the 2nd, 3rd or 11th, and troubled when Mars is debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or afflicted by malefics.
common_outcomes: money made through land, litigation and dealings with rulers; more land and cattle (Phaladeepika 19.20)
wealth through fire, rulers, fighting and the like, and also through medicine, deceit and harsh dealings (Phaladeepika 19.9; Jataka Parijata 18.84)
quarrels with brothers, sons, wife, relatives and elders (Phaladeepika 19.9, 19.20; Jataka Parijata 18.84)
illness from bile, blood, fever and heat (Phaladeepika 19.9, 19.20; Jataka Parijata 18.84)
when well placed: land, fulfilled wishes, clarity of mind, courage, money, defeat of enemies, support of younger siblings (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI, p. 144-145)
when strong: high position, recognition from government, wealth and land, gains from abroad, vehicles and ornaments, harmony with siblings (BPHS 47.27-30)
rare_outcomes: rise to a kingdom or command at the head of a large army, when exalted Mars is in the 10th or 11th or in an upward-facing sign (Phaladeepika 20.25)
loss of eyesight or injury to the eye, cuts from weapons, when Mars is unfavourable (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI, p. 145)
mortgaging of landed property and loss of spouse and children for Mars in Libra (Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, p. 245)
having to eat poor, unwholesome food (Jataka Parijata 18.84)

by_area.personality: Courage, effort and clarity of mind when Mars is favourable (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI); a harsher, scheming streak and envy of others' fortune when it is not (Phaladeepika 19.9).
by_area.career: High administrative or political position and government recognition when Mars is strong (BPHS 47.27-30); income through rulers, fighting, the military, medicine or fire (Phaladeepika 19.9, 19.20); military success and respect for skill for Mars in Capricorn (Raman). Trouble with rulers and superiors when Mars is afflicted (Uttara Kalamrita; Raman for Cancer and Aquarius).
by_area.finance: Wealth through valour, land and property, gains from abroad (BPHS 47.27-31); money through land and litigation, but also loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 19.20); loss of wealth and distress when Mars is debilitated or in a dusthana (BPHS 47.33).
by_area.health: Fevers and illness from bile, blood and heat (Phaladeepika 19.9, 19.20; Jataka Parijata 18.84); wounds, cuts from weapons and eye trouble when Mars is unfavourable (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from spouse and children when Mars is strong in a kendra or the 3rd (BPHS 47.31-32); quarrels with wife and children and liaisons with low company otherwise (Phaladeepika 19.9; Jataka Parijata 18.84).
by_area.family: Siblings are central: happiness and good relations with co-borns when Mars is strong (BPHS 47.30; Uttara Kalamrita), quarrels with brothers and relatives when it is not (Phaladeepika 19.20; Raman for Cancer, Libra).

strengtheners: Mars exalted, in its moolatrikona or own sign (BPHS 47.27-30)
Mars strong in a kendra, the 11th or the 2nd, in a benefic navamsa, joined or aspected by benefics (BPHS 47.27-30)
Mars strong in a kendra or the 3rd: wealth through valour and victory (BPHS 47.31)
Mars as yogakaraka for Cancer and Leo lagnas, and as 2nd and 9th lord for Pisces lagna (Santhanam's note to BPHS 47.33; Laghu Parashari v. 12)
Mars vargottama (Phaladeepika 20.22)
Mars exalted in the 10th or 11th, or in an upward-facing sign (Phaladeepika 20.25)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or joined or aspected by malefics (BPHS 47.33)
a malefic in depression, an enemy sign, the 6th or the 12th gives intense misery in its dasha (Phaladeepika 20.27)
Mars combust (BPHS 47.6, general rule as read in the Sanskrit gloss; Phaladeepika 20.22: mixed results)
Mars's dasha falling fifth in the sequence from birth is called dangerous (Phaladeepika 20.24)
Mars in Cancer, Libra or Aquarius (Raman, ch. XXIV)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 47.32: when Mars is strong in a kendra or the 3rd, some unfavourable effects come at the end of the dasha (the Sanskrit gloss: happiness at the start, trouble at the end). BPHS 47.3-4: a planet in the first decanate of its sign gives its results at the start of the dasha, the second in the middle, the third at the end; the order reverses if the planet is retrograde. Phaladeepika 20.57: a weak Mars in an auspicious sign or navamsa gives its good results in the latter half.
library_entry.disagreements: Phaladeepika and Jataka Parijata describe the dasha mostly in mixed or harsh terms (gains through land and fighting, but quarrels and bile/blood illness), while BPHS makes it strongly good or bad depending on dignity and house. Santhanam's BPHS 47.32 says the strong-Mars dasha has some unfavourable effects at its end; the Sanskrit gloss reads it as happiness at the start and trouble at the end. Santhanam lists the favourable houses as kendra, 11th and 2nd; the gloss adds trikona. Raman makes Cancer (debilitation) and also Libra and Aquarius bad signs, but Santhanam's note makes Mars a yogakaraka for Cancer lagna, so sign and functional role can pull in opposite directions.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as a high-energy, effort-driven period: good for property, initiative, competition and courage, with a need to manage temper, disputes (especially with siblings and family) and heat-related health. Stress the favourable version only when the chart shows a strong or yogakaraka Mars. Do not predict deaths, accidents or surgery; at most suggest care with health, safety and conflict.

library_entry.summary: Mars's own sub-period at the start of its mahadasha (about 4 months 27 days) is described by Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman as heated and quarrelsome: illness from heat and bile, wounds, friction with siblings and friends, trouble from rulers. BPHS makes it good (royal favour, recovery of lost position and wealth, property, a son) when Mars is in a kendra, trikona, the 2nd, 3rd or 11th, or exalted or in its own sign.
common_outcomes: illness from bile and heat, wounds, separation from brothers, money from land and litigation, trouble from cousins, fire, enemies, rulers and thieves (Phaladeepika 21.21)
great heat, dislike of friends, annoyance from brothers, danger from a ruler, failure of undertakings (Jataka Parijata 18.85)
the same, plus quarrels with relatives, loss of money, skin trouble, loss of blood, boils and anal fissures (Raman, pp. 245-246)
rare_outcomes: recovery of a lost kingdom or high position (BPHS 54.1-2)
anxiety through foreigners or warlike people, open violence (Raman, p. 246)

by_area.personality: Heat of temper and dislike of friends (Jataka Parijata 18.85; Raman).
by_area.career: Royal or government favour and reinstatement in position when Mars is well placed (BPHS 54.1-4); danger from rulers and failure of undertakings otherwise (Jataka Parijata 18.85; Raman).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth, house, land and cattle when well placed (BPHS 54.1-4); money from land and litigation (Phaladeepika 21.21); loss of money (Raman).
by_area.health: Bile and heat disorders, wounds (Phaladeepika 21.21); urinary trouble and wounds when Mars is in the 8th or 12th or afflicted (BPHS 54.5); mental agony and bodily pain if Mars rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.6).
by_area.relationships: Birth of a son when Mars is well placed (BPHS 54.1-3).
by_area.family: Separation from or annoyance with brothers (Phaladeepika 21.21; Jataka Parijata 18.85; Raman).

strengtheners: Mars in a kendra, the 5th, 9th, 11th, 3rd or 2nd, or joined with the lagna lord (BPHS 54.1-2)
Mars exalted, in its own sign or own navamsa, with strength (BPHS 54.3-4)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars in the 8th or 12th, or joined or aspected by malefics (BPHS 54.5)
Mars as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.6)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS makes this sub-period clearly good under the listed houses and dignities; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give mostly troublesome results without conditions, though Phaladeepika also gives money from land. Santhanam and the Sanskrit gloss differ on verse 6 (2nd or 7th lord vs the 7th lord in the 2nd) and on the colour of the bull.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Describe a hot, driven start to the Mars period: advise patience with siblings and colleagues, care against injuries and heat-related illness, and prudence with officials. Mention property gains and recognition only when the chart shows the favourable placements.

library_entry.summary: Rahu's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 1 year 18 days) is one of the hardest in every source: danger from rulers, thieves, weapons, fire and poison, loss of wealth and of relatives, illness, even imprisonment. BPHS allows good results (honours, property, business profit, pilgrimage, foreign travel) when Rahu is exalted or in moolatrikona, or in a kendra, trikona or the 11th with benefics.
common_outcomes: danger from weapons, fire, thieves, enemies and rulers, poison, disease of belly, eyes and head, loss of elders and relatives (Phaladeepika 21.22)
peril from rulers and robbers, loss of wealth and grain, success in wrong pursuits (Jataka Parijata 18.86)
danger from rulers and robbers, loss of wealth, poisoning, loss of relatives, skin disease, change of residence, scandal, loss of cattle, fear of insects and thieves, imprisonment (Raman, p. 246)
rare_outcomes: bathing in holy rivers like the Ganges, foreign journeys, extraordinary business profit (BPHS 54.9-10)
falls into a well, famine, fear of ghosts, gonorrhoea (Raman, p. 246)

by_area.personality: Loss of memory and fretting (Raman).
by_area.career: Recognition from government when Rahu is well placed (BPHS 54.9-10); danger from rulers and imprisonment otherwise (BPHS 54.11-12; Jataka Parijata 18.86).
by_area.finance: Extraordinary business profit, house and land when well placed (BPHS 54.9-10); loss of wealth in the 2nd (BPHS 54.13) and in general (Jataka Parijata; Raman).
by_area.health: Wounds, vata and pitta disorders (BPHS 54.12); poison, belly, eye and head disease (Phaladeepika 21.22); skin disease (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from a son and gain of a wife when well placed (BPHS 54.10); great danger in the 7th (BPHS 54.13).
by_area.family: Loss of elders and relatives (Phaladeepika 21.22; Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Pilgrimage and bathing in holy rivers when well placed (BPHS 54.10).

strengtheners: Rahu exalted or in moolatrikona, or in a kendra, the 5th, 9th or 11th, with benefics (BPHS 54.9-10)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 8th or 12th, or joined or aspected by malefics (BPHS 54.11-12)
Rahu in the 2nd (loss of wealth) or the 7th (danger to life) (BPHS 54.13)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS gives a favourable version under specific placements; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only troublesome results. Santhanam reads the favourable condition as placement 'and associated with benefics'; the Sanskrit gloss lists the placements and benefic contact as alternatives.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present as a period calling for caution: legal matters, safety while travelling, health checks, and care with money and with people of doubtful intent. Mention the favourable version only when Rahu is well placed. Do not predict death, poisoning or imprisonment.

library_entry.summary: Jupiter's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 11 months 6 days) is a good part of the period in most sources: religious activity, honours, wealth, property, health and children. BPHS spoils it when Jupiter is in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, combust, afflicted or weak, and warns of danger when Jupiter rules the 2nd (or 7th).
common_outcomes: worship of Brahmins and gods, visits to holy places, meritorious acts, hospitality, new children and friends (Phaladeepika 21.23)
wealth and land through Brahmins, freedom from illness, public esteem, ascendancy and happiness (Jataka Parijata 18.87)
end of the unfortunate time, favour from superiors, money, birth of children, wealth through holy people (Raman, pp. 246-247)
rare_outcomes: severe ear disease or phlegm complaints (Phaladeepika 21.23)
trouble from spirits, loss of servants and siblings when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 54.20-22)

by_area.career: Honours from government, success in business (BPHS 54.15-19); favour from superiors (Raman); wrath of rulers if Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 54.20-21).
by_area.finance: Increase of wealth, grain, property, cattle (BPHS 54.15-19); wealth and land through Brahmins (Jataka Parijata 18.87).
by_area.health: Sound health (BPHS 54.19; Jataka Parijata 18.87); ear and phlegm complaints (Phaladeepika 21.23); bile disease when afflicted (BPHS 54.21); fever if Jupiter rules the 2nd (BPHS 54.22).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children (BPHS 54.16, 54.19); new children (Phaladeepika 21.23; Raman).
by_area.family: Happiness at home (BPHS 54.16); loss of siblings when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 54.22).
by_area.spirituality: Worship, pilgrimage to holy places and meritorious deeds (Phaladeepika 21.23).

strengtheners: Jupiter in a kendra, the 5th, 9th, 11th or 2nd from the lagna, or in its exalted or own navamsa (BPHS 54.15-16)
Jupiter in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Mars, or with the lords of the 9th, 10th, 4th or lagna (BPHS 54.17-19)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, combust, with or aspected by malefics, or weak (BPHS 54.20-21)
Jupiter as lord of the 2nd (Santhanam) or 2nd/7th (gloss) (BPHS 54.22)
library_entry.disagreements: Santhanam's OCR reads the bad houses as 5th, 8th, 12th; the Sanskrit gloss gives 6th, 8th, 12th (used here). Santhanam names the 2nd lord only; the gloss names the lord of the 2nd and 7th. Uttara Kalamrita promises raja yoga from strong Mars and Jupiter; its translator disagrees from experience.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Describe as a welcome easing within the Mars period: support from mentors, family happiness, devotion, property. If Jupiter is afflicted, advise care with health and officials without forecasting danger to life.

library_entry.summary: Saturn's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 1 year 1 month 9 days) is the most dreaded of the period: illness, loss of wealth and property, trouble from rulers, thieves and enemies, distress to family. BPHS gives a good version (honours, wealth, children) when Saturn is in a kendra, trikona, its own sign or moolatrikona, or with benefics, but unusually makes Saturn's good position from Mars bad.
common_outcomes: trouble after trouble to children, wife and elders, grief, loss and theft of wealth, illness from heat and wind (Phaladeepika 21.24)
illness bringing much misery, threats from enemies, robbers and rulers, loss of wealth (Jataka Parijata 18.88)
loss of money, illness, loss of relatives, danger from weapons or surgery, litigation, loss of property and position (Raman, p. 247)
rare_outcomes: results falling on Saturdays and in Saturn's month (BPHS 54.25)
defeat in battle and loss from selling farm land (BPHS 54.30-32)

by_area.personality: Mental agony (BPHS 54.27-32); violent or wrongful acts and ill repute when Saturn is in a kendra, 5th or 11th from Mars (BPHS 54.30-31).
by_area.career: Royal recognition and fame when Saturn is well placed (BPHS 54.23-25); loss of position, punishment by rulers, imprisonment otherwise (BPHS 54.26-32; Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth and grain when well placed (BPHS 54.24); loss of wealth, farm produce and land otherwise (BPHS 54.26, 54.32; Phaladeepika 21.24; Jataka Parijata 18.88).
by_area.health: Disease (BPHS 54.26); urinary trouble (BPHS 54.32); rheumatism and pains (BPHS 54.33-34); heat and wind illness (Phaladeepika 21.24).
by_area.relationships: Distress to wife and children (BPHS 54.29; Phaladeepika 21.24).
by_area.family: Children and grandchildren when well placed (BPHS 54.25); loss of siblings and family quarrels otherwise (BPHS 54.28-29).

strengtheners: Saturn in a kendra or trikona, its own sign or moolatrikona, an exalted or own navamsa, or with the lagna lord or benefics (BPHS 54.23-25)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn debilitated or in an enemy sign, or in the 8th or 12th (BPHS 54.26)
Saturn as 2nd or 7th lord with malefics (BPHS 54.27-29)
Saturn in a kendra, the 5th or 11th from Mars (BPHS 54.30-32)
Saturn in the 8th or 12th from Mars with malefics (BPHS 54.33-34)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS's rule that Saturn well placed from Mars (kendra, 5th, 11th) gives bad results reverses the usual principle; Santhanam flags this. Santhanam lists kendra, 11th and 5th from Mars; the gloss reads kendra, 11th or trikona. Uttara Kalamrita's results-exchange rule makes the sub-period reflect Mars's own condition, which the other texts do not say.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Treat as a demanding stretch that rewards caution: avoid conflicts with authorities, review legal and property matters, look after health and family. Mention the favourable version only when Saturn is well placed from the lagna. Never predict death or imprisonment.

library_entry.summary: Mercury's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 11 months 27 days) is mixed. BPHS gives religious and diplomatic activity, authority, vehicles and success in farming when Mercury is in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, and very high results when it is in a kendra or trikona from Mars; the other texts and Raman stress enemies, thieves and worry alongside trade gains.
common_outcomes: fear of enemies, trouble from thieves, loss of wealth, loss of cattle and horses, harassment by rulers (Phaladeepika 21.25)
wealth from traders, plenty of houses, cattle and grain, trouble from enemies and mental worry (Jataka Parijata 18.89)
marriage or inclination to it, knowledge, wealth through trade, trouble from enemies, worry, success in litigation (Raman, p. 247)
rare_outcomes: command of an army, music, discussions on scripture (BPHS 54.41-43)
poisoning by insects or animals (Raman, p. 247)

by_area.personality: Inclination to diplomacy and fame (BPHS 54.36-37); harsh speech and sinful thinking when Mercury is badly placed from Mars (BPHS 54.44-45).
by_area.career: Authority in government service (BPHS 54.37); high position and command (BPHS 54.41-43); antagonism with government when joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40).
by_area.finance: Gains from trade, houses, cattle and grain (Jataka Parijata 18.89; Raman); loss of wealth and cattle (Phaladeepika 21.25; BPHS 54.38-39).
by_area.health: Heart disease when Mercury is debilitated, combust or in a dusthana (BPHS 54.38-39); many ailments when joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40); critical illness if Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.46).
by_area.relationships: Marriage or wish to marry (Raman); distress to wife and children when Mercury is badly placed (BPHS 54.38-39).
by_area.family: Quarrels with kinsmen when joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40); loss of kinsmen (BPHS 54.39).
by_area.spirituality: Company of holy people, japa, charity and religious rites (BPHS 54.36); discussion of scriptures and Puranas (BPHS 54.43).

strengtheners: Mercury in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 54.36-37)
Mercury in a kendra, trikona or exalted, from Mars (BPHS 54.41-43)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury debilitated, combust or in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 54.38-39)
Mercury joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40)
Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars or with malefics (BPHS 54.44-45)
Mercury as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 54.46)
library_entry.disagreements: Phaladeepika gives only adverse results; Jataka Parijata and Raman mix trade gains with enemies and worry; BPHS turns on placement. Santhanam and the gloss differ on whether verse 44 refers to Mercury or the dasha lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: A mixed sub-period: good for trade, study, negotiation and settling disputes, with a need to guard against rivals, careless speech and travel risks. Advise attention to heart and general health only when the chart shows the afflicted conditions.

library_entry.summary: Ketu's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 4 months 27 days) is turbulent in Phaladeepika and Raman: sudden danger from fire and weapons, quarrels, trouble from relatives and low people, possible departure from home. BPHS gives royal favour, wealth, land and a son when Ketu is in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th, or with benefics.
common_outcomes: danger from lightning, sudden trouble from fire and weapons, leaving one's country or loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.26)
opposition of bad people (Jataka Parijata 18.90, partly illegible in the scan)
quarrels with low people, loss of money, sins, trouble from relatives and brothers, family disputes, poisonous complaints, trouble through women, many enemies (Raman, pp. 247-248)
rare_outcomes: command of an army and friendship with rulers when Ketu is a strong yogakaraka (BPHS 54.50-51)
tooth trouble, dysentery, leprosy, distress from tigers (BPHS 54.52-53)

by_area.career: Government favour and authority when Ketu is well placed (BPHS 54.48-49); generalship and friendship with officials if Ketu is a yogakaraka (BPHS 54.50-51).
by_area.finance: Wealth, a little land early and more later (BPHS 54.49); loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.26; Raman; BPHS 54.54).
by_area.health: Fever, dysentery, tooth trouble when Ketu is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars (BPHS 54.52-53); disease in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.54).
by_area.relationships: Distress to wife and children (BPHS 54.53); trouble through women (Raman).
by_area.family: Birth of a son when well placed (BPHS 54.49); disputes with relatives and brothers (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Performance of oblations when Ketu is a yogakaraka (BPHS 54.51).

strengtheners: Ketu in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th, or with or aspected by benefics (BPHS 54.48-49)
Ketu a yogakaraka (joined with one) and strong (BPHS 54.50-51)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars (BPHS 54.52-53)
Ketu in the 2nd or 7th from the lagna (BPHS 54.54)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 54.49: when Ketu is well placed, only small gains of land at the start of the sub-period and substantial gains later.
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS gives a favourable version for good placements; Phaladeepika and Raman give only adverse results. Santhanam reads verse 52 as Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars; the Sanskrit gloss garbles it.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Short and unsettled: advise care with fire, sharp tools, travel and family disputes. Mention the favourable version when Ketu is well placed. Do not predict the death of the native or spouse.

library_entry.summary: Venus's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 1 year 2 months) brings comforts, money from relatives, jewels and clothes, and in BPHS high position and luxury when Venus is in a kendra, exalted, in its own sign or a trikona lord. Phaladeepika is harsher (defeat, residence abroad, theft, eye trouble), and BPHS gives losses when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars.
common_outcomes: jewels for the wife, clothes, money from relatives, but odium of women and their company (Jataka Parijata 18.91)
property or money, domestic happiness, love affairs, festivities, travel pleasure, skin eruptions (Raman, p. 248)
defeat in battle, residence abroad, theft, left-eye trouble, loss of servants (Phaladeepika 21.27)
rare_outcomes: construction of wells and reservoirs and charitable works when Venus is linked to the 10th lord (BPHS 54.60)
elephants and horses (BPHS 54.55-56)

by_area.personality: Increase of intelligence (Raman).
by_area.career: High position in government (BPHS 54.55-56); gains from the employer (BPHS 54.57-58).
by_area.finance: Property, money from relatives, houses, land and villages by official favour (BPHS 54.57-59; Jataka Parijata 18.91); loss of wealth when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars (BPHS 54.61-62).
by_area.health: Skin eruptions and boils (Raman); bodily pain if Venus rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.63); left-eye trouble (Phaladeepika 21.27).
by_area.relationships: Happiness of wife and children and good fortune when Venus is linked to the lagna lord (BPHS 54.56); love affairs and gifts to the wife (Raman; Jataka Parijata 18.91); disrepute through women (Jataka Parijata 18.91).
by_area.family: Celebrations of a son's birth (BPHS 54.57); dissensions in the family when badly placed (BPHS 54.62).
by_area.spirituality: Holy bathing, religious and charitable works (BPHS 54.59-60); religious observances (Raman).

strengtheners: Venus in a kendra, exalted, in its own sign, or lord of the 1st, 5th or 9th (BPHS 54.55-56)
Venus in the 5th, 9th, 11th or 2nd from Mars (BPHS 54.57-58)
Venus linked to the lagna lord or the 10th lord (BPHS 54.56, 54.60)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars, or with malefics (BPHS 54.61-62)
Venus as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.63)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 54.59: when Venus is well placed from Mars, the last part of the sub-period brings music and dance and bathing in holy waters.
library_entry.disagreements: Phaladeepika gives a hard version (defeat, exile, theft) where BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Raman are mostly favourable. Santhanam and the gloss differ on the houses from the lagna and from Mars, and on the colour of the donated cow.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Generally a pleasant interval: comforts, relationships, family celebrations, property and charity. Advise care with reputation in relationships and with eye and skin health where the chart is weak.

library_entry.summary: The Sun's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 4 months 6 days) joins two fiery friends: honour from authorities, fame and power won through boldness (Phaladeepika, BPHS when the Sun is strong), but also blame and quarrels with elders, fever and heart-ache (Jataka Parijata, Raman). BPHS makes it bad when the Sun is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars or with malefics.
common_outcomes: honour from the sovereign, fame and power from conflict, servants, wealth and wider livelihood through daring (Phaladeepika 21.28)
blame, odium of elders and quarrels with them, illness, heart-ache caused by one's own people (Jataka Parijata 18.92)
money by questionable means, defeat of enemies, good reputation, long journeys, blame and quarrels with elders, fever, danger of fire, many enemies (Raman, p. 248)
rare_outcomes: an audience with high officials in a foreign land (BPHS 54.66, gloss)
danger from snakes and poison if the Sun rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.68)

by_area.personality: Courage and potency (BPHS 54.66).
by_area.career: Recognition by government, meetings with high officials, extraordinary profits in business (BPHS 54.64-66); honour and power through daring deeds (Phaladeepika 21.28); failure in ventures when afflicted (BPHS 54.67).
by_area.finance: Growth of wealth (BPHS 54.65); wealth through daring (Phaladeepika 21.28); money by bad means (Raman).
by_area.health: Sound health when well placed (BPHS 54.66); headaches, fever, dysentery when the Sun is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars (BPHS 54.67-68); fever and inflammation (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Birth of a son (BPHS 54.65).
by_area.family: Harmony in the family (BPHS 54.65); quarrels with elders (Jataka Parijata 18.92; Raman); distress to a son if the Sun rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.68).

strengtheners: Sun exalted, in its own sign, or in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, together with the lords of the 10th and 11th (BPHS 54.64-66)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Sun in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars, or with malefics (BPHS 54.67)
Sun as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.68)
library_entry.disagreements: Phaladeepika is wholly favourable; Jataka Parijata wholly adverse; Raman combines both. Santhanam and the gloss differ on which lords (10th and 11th vs 9th and 10th) must join the Sun, and on the remedy (Sun worship vs shanti rites).
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present as a short window for recognition, leadership and bold initiatives, while advising tact with elders and superiors and attention to fever or heat-related complaints.

library_entry.summary: The Moon's sub-period closing Mars's dasha (about 7 months) is mainly favourable in every source: wealth, comforts, home improvements, marriages and festivities, favour from authorities. BPHS scales the good with the Moon's waxing, and gives serious losses and danger when the Moon is debilitated, in an enemy sign, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: various kinds of wealth and children, freedom from enemies, clothes, bed, ornaments and jewels, trouble to elders, spleen or bile complaints (Phaladeepika 21.29)
comforts of wealth, clothes, pearls, gems, ornaments, heavy sleep, ardent passion (Jataka Parijata 18.93)
profit, wealth, house renovated or improved, comforts, heavy sleep, passion (Raman, p. 249)
rare_outcomes: construction of reservoirs and cow shelters (BPHS 54.71)
danger of war (BPHS 54.74)

by_area.career: Promotion to a high position and success in desired projects by official favour (BPHS 54.70-73).
by_area.finance: Wealth and property (BPHS 54.72-73; Phaladeepika 21.29; Raman); loss of land, wealth and cattle when the Moon is badly placed (BPHS 54.74).
by_area.health: Spleen or bile trouble (Phaladeepika 21.29); bodily distress and mental agony if the Moon rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.75-76).
by_area.relationships: Marriage and festivities, happiness of wife and children (BPHS 54.72); passion (Jataka Parijata 18.93); distress to wife and children when badly placed (BPHS 54.74).
by_area.family: Good relations with parents (BPHS 54.72); trouble to elders (Phaladeepika 21.29).
by_area.spirituality: Merit through public works such as reservoirs (BPHS 54.71).

strengtheners: Moon exalted or in its own sign, or in a kendra, the 9th, 4th or 10th with the lords of those houses (BPHS 54.70-73)
waxing Moon gives the good results in full (BPHS 54.73)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon debilitated or in an enemy sign, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Mars (BPHS 54.74)
Moon as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.75)
waning Moon reduces the good results (BPHS 54.73)
library_entry.disagreements: Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman are favourable without conditions; BPHS adds a severe adverse version. Santhanam and the gloss differ on the houses in verse 74 and on whether a cow and buffalo are to be donated.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: A comfortable close to the Mars period: home, family events, rest and material ease. If the Moon is weak, advise care for family members' health and finances without forecasting deaths.

library_entry.summary: Rahu's 18-year mahadasha is described by the classical texts as an unsettling period of sudden rises and losses, foreign or unconventional contacts, trouble from authorities, hidden illness and family strain, unless Rahu is well placed (exalted, in a favourable sign, in an upachaya or good house, or joined with benefics or a yogakaraka), when it can give power, wealth, property and recognition, often through foreigners or the state. Gains made in it are repeatedly said to be unstable and liable to be lost toward the end.
common_outcomes: trouble or displeasure from rulers and officials, removal from office or loss of status (Phaladeepika 19.14, 19.21)
danger from thieves, poison, fire and weapons (Phaladeepika 19.14, 19.21)
mental unrest and anxiety (Phaladeepika 19.14; BPHS 47.40-43 when afflicted)
illness or trouble to spouse and children, loss of or separation from relatives (Phaladeepika 19.14, 19.21; BPHS 47.40-43; Jataka Parijata 18.96)
an obscure, hard-to-diagnose illness; eye and head complaints (Phaladeepika 19.21)
living or wandering in a foreign or distant place (Jataka Parijata 18.96)
when Rahu is well placed: wealth, property, vehicles and recognition through friends, the state or a foreign government (BPHS 47.34-39)
rare_outcomes: rise to near-royal affluence and wide fame when Rahu is with a benefic and outside the 6th, 8th and 12th (Phaladeepika 19.15)
command of an army, kingly status (Jataka Parijata 18.108, sign list corrupt in the scan)
insults from lowly people, scandal, leg injury, failure of undertakings (Phaladeepika 19.14)
imprisonment for fraud or political offences when Rahu is in Leo; miscarriage or loss of a child when Rahu is in Scorpio (B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV)
political rise, often after the fall of a mentor or leader, when Rahu is tied to the Amatyakaraka or the lagna lord (Sanjay Rath, srath.com)

by_area.personality: Restless, anxious or ill-natured moods are named (Phaladeepika 19.14, 19.21); irritability with Rahu in Gemini, mean tendencies in Aquarius (Raman). Frawley describes the period as dispersing energy and drawing attention toward what is foreign or distant.
by_area.career: Removal from office, failed undertakings and trouble from rulers are the default (Phaladeepika 19.14, 19.21). Well placed, Rahu gives comforts and wealth through government favour or a foreign government (BPHS 47.34-39), sudden promotion and state recognition in Capricorn, high position in Virgo (Raman). Loss of position when afflicted (BPHS 47.40-43).
by_area.finance: Loss of wealth at the start of an afflicted period (BPHS 47.40-43); wealth, crops and new house when exalted (BPHS 47.34-39); landholdings, vehicles and servants in Virgo, Pisces or Scorpio, liable to be lost at the end (Phaladeepika 19.16). Raman lists effortless gains in Sagittarius and sudden riches in Virgo, losses and litigation in Libra.
by_area.health: Obscure, hard-to-diagnose illness, poisoning, eye and head ailments (Phaladeepika 19.21); severe illness (Jataka Parijata 18.96); leg injury (Phaladeepika 19.14).
by_area.relationships: Trouble to spouse and children when Rahu is afflicted (BPHS 47.40-43); loss of or separation from wife and children (Phaladeepika 19.21; Jataka Parijata 18.96); disputes with friends (Phaladeepika 19.21). Domestic and marital happiness when Rahu is in Virgo or Aries (Raman).
by_area.family: Loss of relatives (Phaladeepika 19.14); illness to children (Phaladeepika 19.14); bereavement of parents at the end of the period (Jataka Parijata 18.109); sons and domestic happiness when well placed (BPHS 47.34-39).
by_area.spirituality: Religious inclination when Rahu is exalted (BPHS 47.34-39); pilgrimages and philosophical study with Rahu in Taurus, humanitarian service in Cancer, household recitation of sacred texts in Aries (Raman).

strengtheners: Rahu exalted (Taurus) (BPHS 47.34-39)
Rahu with or aspected by benefics, in a benefic's sign, in the 1st, 3rd, 4th, 7th, 10th or 11th (BPHS 47.34-39)
Rahu with a benefic and outside the 6th, 8th and 12th (Phaladeepika 19.15)

Rahu in a kendra or trikona and connected with a kendra or trikona lord becomes a yogakaraka (Phaladeepika 20.52); Santhanam's note to BPHS 47 says association with a yogakaraka makes Rahu very beneficial
Rahu in a sign owned by a benefic and connected with a planet gives good results in that planet's sub-periods (Phaladeepika 20.53)
Rahu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th (Santhanam's note closing BPHS ch. 48)
a strong, well-placed lord of the sign Rahu occupies (Raman: the nodes give the results of the lords of the houses they occupy)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 8th or 12th: troubles throughout (BPHS 47.40-43)
Rahu with a malefic or with a maraka planet, or debilitated (Scorpio): loss of status and residence, mental agony, trouble to spouse and children (BPHS 47.40-43)
a benefic joined to Rahu can be spoiled and cause harm, especially near the end of its own period (Phaladeepika 20.39)
Rahu in Gemini, Leo, Libra, Scorpio or Aquarius (Raman's sign list)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 47.40-43 (Santhanam), for an afflicted Rahu: wealth is lost at the start, there is some relief and gain in one's own country in the middle, and anxiety and distress come at the end. Jataka Parijata 18.109: distress at the start, considerable enjoyment in the middle, bereavement of parents and loss of status at the end. Phaladeepika 19.16 and Jataka Parijata 18.107: gains made under a well-placed Rahu may be lost when the period ends. BPHS 47.3-4: the period's results are timed by the drekkana Rahu occupies (1st, 2nd or 3rd drekkana gives results at the start, middle or end); Santhanam's note reverses this order for the always-retrograde nodes.
library_entry.disagreements: Signs: Phaladeepika 19.16 counts Scorpio among Rahu's good signs, while Santhanam's BPHS 47 and Raman treat Scorpio as Rahu's debilitation with harmful results. Aquarius is Rahu's own sign in Santhanam's BPHS, yet Raman lists it among the worst placements. Jataka Parijata names Cancer in two different sign groups, and its lists do not match Raman's. Phases: BPHS (afflicted case) gives loss at the start, some relief in the middle and distress at the end; Jataka Parijata gives distress at the start, enjoyment in the middle, and bereavement and loss of status at the end; Phaladeepika 19.16 says gains are lost at the end. Sutton is reported as calling the first and last years the hardest. Lordship: Raman says the nodes give the results of the lord of the house they occupy; Phaladeepika 20.39 stresses the planet joined with Rahu instead; BPHS 47 judges Rahu by its own sign and associations.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Describe Rahu's period as one of ambition, change and unusual opportunities, with the warning that gains can be unstable, and that health, family and dealings with authority need care. Say which conditions in the chart point toward the favourable or the difficult version. Never predict death, poisoning or loss of family members as certain; rephrase maraka lines as a time to take extra care of health. Offer remedies only as traditional practices.

library_entry.summary: Rahu's own sub-period at the start of its mahadasha (about 2 years 8 months 12 days) is described mostly as a disturbed time: family quarrels, illness of the spouse, fear of poison or snakes, loss of money and wandering far from home. BPHS makes it good, even giving high position, when Rahu is in Cancer, Scorpio, Virgo or Sagittarius, in an upachaya house, or joined with a yogakaraka.
common_outcomes: danger from poison, water-borne illness or a venomous snake (Phaladeepika 21.30)
separation from loved ones, harsh words, mental distress (Phaladeepika 21.30)
illness of the wife, disputes, poor judgement, loss of wealth, wandering in a distant land (Jataka Parijata 18.97)
quarrels in the family, scandal, fever, wounds or insect bites, court testimony, weakened memory, distant wandering (Raman, p. 251)
rare_outcomes: death of a partner or of the head of the family (Raman, p. 251)
adultery (Phaladeepika 21.30)
a kingdom or high office, royal favour (BPHS 55.1-4 when well placed)

by_area.personality: Mental disturbance, poor judgement and weakened memory (Jataka Parijata 18.97; Raman p. 251).
by_area.career: Friction with officials when Rahu is badly placed (BPHS 55.5-6); high position, government favour and professional success when it is well placed (BPHS 55.1-4). Raman notes testimony in court.
by_area.finance: Loss of wealth (Jataka Parijata 18.97; Raman); gains of clothes, vehicles, ornaments and property when well placed (BPHS 55.1-4).
by_area.health: Poisoning, water-borne illness, snake danger (Phaladeepika 21.30); fever, wounds, insect bites (Raman); distress and disease when Rahu is in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 55.7).
by_area.relationships: Illness of the wife (Jataka Parijata 18.97; Raman); separation from loved ones (Phaladeepika 21.30); distress to spouse and children when badly placed (BPHS 55.5-6).
by_area.family: Loss of kin and family quarrels (BPHS 55.5-6; Raman).

strengtheners: Rahu in Cancer, Scorpio, Virgo or Sagittarius (BPHS 55.1)
Rahu in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th, with benefic aspect or a yogakaraka (BPHS 55.3)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 8th or 12th, or with malefics (BPHS 55.5-6)
Rahu in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 55.7)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS makes this sub-period good under the listed signs and houses, while Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only troublesome results with no conditions. Santhanam reads verse 7 as Rahu 'lord of or placed in' the 2nd or 7th; the Sanskrit gloss reads it as the 2nd or 7th lord in the 7th.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as an unsettled opening phase: advise care with health, family harmony and paperwork with officials. Mention the favourable version only when the chart shows the listed placements. Do not predict the death of a spouse or family member.

library_entry.summary: Jupiter's sub-period in Rahu's dasha (about 2 years 4 months 24 days) is one of the better parts of the period in every source: illness and enemies recede, royal favour, wealth, children and religious activity. BPHS makes it bad if Jupiter is debilitated, combust, in an enemy sign, in a dusthana or with malefics, and warns of danger when Jupiter is a maraka.
common_outcomes: enemies and ailments subside; royal favour, wealth, children, perseverance (Jataka Parijata 18.98)
happiness, worship of gods and Brahmins, good health, study of scripture (Phaladeepika 21.31)
gains through nobles and superiors, success, a marriage in the family (Raman, p. 252)
rare_outcomes: gain of a village (BPHS 55.12)
also more enemies, litigation, and bathing in a sacred river (Raman, p. 252)

by_area.personality: Steadiness of mind and patience when Jupiter is well placed (BPHS 55.9).
by_area.career: Position, victory over rivals and royal favour (BPHS 55.8-12); support from superiors (Raman). Loss of authority or government displeasure when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 55.13-14).
by_area.finance: Wealth grows steadily, like the waxing Moon; vehicles and cattle (BPHS 55.10); land and food (BPHS 55.15-17). Loss of wealth when Jupiter is afflicted or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.13-14, 55.18).
by_area.health: Good health (Phaladeepika 21.31); illness lifts (Jataka Parijata 18.98). Heart disease when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 55.13-14); bodily distress when in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.18).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children (BPHS 55.12-13); a marriage at home (Raman).
by_area.family: Joy from the birth of a son (BPHS 55.13, Sanskrit gloss); family distress when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 55.13-14).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to gods and Brahmins, pilgrimages, study of scripture (BPHS 55.12; Phaladeepika 21.31); charity and dharma (BPHS 55.16).

strengtheners: Jupiter exalted, in its own sign, or in an own or exalted navamsa (BPHS 55.8)
Jupiter in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 55.8)
Jupiter strong and in a kendra, trikona, or the 2nd, 3rd or 11th from Rahu (BPHS 55.15-17)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter debilitated, combust, in an enemy sign, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with malefics (BPHS 55.13-14)
Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.18)
Jupiter as a maraka (BPHS 55.19)
library_entry.phases: The Sanskrit gloss of BPHS 55.17 says the end of the sub-period may bring royal anger, about two months of bodily suffering, and harm to an elder brother and parents (enjoylearningsanskrit.com; not in Santhanam's rendering as read).
library_entry.disagreements: The unconditional classical lists (Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata) are wholly positive, while BPHS makes the results depend on Jupiter's condition. Raman mixes positive results with litigation and more enemies. Santhanam prints Jupiter as 'lord of the 2nd and 7th' for the maraka result, which Jupiter cannot be; the reading 'lord of the 2nd or 7th' is used here.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present as a period of relief, support from mentors or authorities, and growth in family and faith, qualified by Jupiter's condition. Rephrase the maraka line as a time to look after health. Offer Shiva worship only as a traditional practice.

placement_entries.summary: The Sun in the 2nd ties money and speech to authority. The classics are split: some give wealth that the state can take away, others lack of learning and money; most note trouble in the face, eyes or speech.

Losses through authorities or litigation (Brihat Jataka 20.1; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Stubborn or peevish temper (Raman)
Stammering or faltering speech (Phaladeepika 8.2; Raman HPA)
rare_outcomes: Wealth from minerals or metals, liberal giving, kindness even to ill-wishers (Jataka Parijata 8.62)
Danger in the 25th year (Raman HPA)

by_area.personality: Stubborn and peevish (Raman); in Jataka Parijata liberal and eloquent.
by_area.finance: Brihat Jataka gives great wealth that a ruler takes away; Phaladeepika gives lack of wealth; Raman says money comes by hard effort and its nature follows the sign, with a tendency to waste.
by_area.health: Face, mouth or teeth complaints (Brihat Jataka 20.1, Raman).
by_area.family: PanchangBodh notes the Sun's heat can weigh on family life.

strengtheners: Good aspects: Sastri's note to Brihat Jataka 20.1 says the placement is bad for litigation except when the Sun is well aspected
With Mercury, Budhaditya yoga sharpens speech (PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Unaspected or afflicted, bad for lawsuits and for the face and teeth (Sastri's note to Brihat Jataka 20.1)
placement_entries.disagreements: On wealth: Phaladeepika says poor and unlearned; Brihat Jataka says very rich but robbed by the ruler; Jataka Parijata says liberal and propertied; Raman says good earnings with waste. On speech: Phaladeepika and Raman HPA give stammering, Jataka Parijata and Raman HPA also give eloquent or bright speech.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Talk about earnings linked to status and a forthright way of speaking; advise care with official or legal disputes and with spending for show. Present face or teeth notes as traditional, not as a health forecast.

placement_entries.summary: The Sun in Aquarius is in Saturn's other sign, an enemy. Classical texts give courage but also short temper, unreliable friendships, limited wealth and difficulty through children; results improve greatly with good aspects.
common_outcomes: Courageous and persistent but quick-tempered
Limited or fluctuating money
Friction in friendships or with educated peers
Steady in activity despite dissatisfaction
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka 18.4: loses good fortune through sons, poor
Saravali 22.64-65: gains through relationships outside marriage; disliked by the learned

by_area.personality: Very short-tempered but courageous and firm in activity; unreliable in friendship and miserly (Saravali 22.64-65); stubborn, with self-esteem and rare faculties (Raman HPA ch. XXII).
by_area.career: Raman HPA ch. XXII lists unlucky and unsuccessful; Saravali 22.64-65 says firm in activities.
by_area.finance: Little wealth (Saravali 22.64-65); poor (Brihat Jataka 18.4; Raman).
by_area.health: Saravali 22.64-65 traditionally links this placement to the heart; never present this as a medical prediction.
by_area.relationships: Saravali 22.64-65: not firm in friendship; disliked by the learned.
by_area.family: Brihat Jataka 18.4 says fortune suffers through sons; confirm from the 5th house before mentioning.

strengtheners: Jupiter's aspect (Saravali 22.58-63: fame and wisdom)
Saturn's aspect (Saravali 22.58-63: victory over enemies, honours)
Upachaya placement (3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th), where Braha (pp. 17, 51) says malefics such as the Sun give excellent results
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars's aspect (Saravali 22.58-63: illness and wounds)
Moon's aspect (Saravali 22.58-63: cunning, loss)
Mercury's aspect (Saravali 22.58-63: weakness)
placement_entries.disagreements: Brihat Jataka focuses on poverty and children; Saravali adds courage and steadiness, giving a more mixed picture.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as courage with a need to manage temper and money. Avoid any heart-health claims and do not predict trouble with children.

placement_entries.summary: The Moon in the 12th is classically unhappy: isolation, low spirits, sloth and feeling slighted, with life abroad or in retreat as a theme.
common_outcomes: Unhappy, miserable or obstructed (Phaladeepika 8.7, Raman)
Prefers an obscure or solitary life (Raman)
Defect or deformity in some limb (Brihat Jataka 20.5; Raman)
Lazy or lethargic (Phaladeepika 8.7; Raman with a waning Moon and Saturn)
rare_outcomes: Lives in a foreign country (Jataka Parijata 8.97)
Disliked by others and insulted (Phaladeepika 8.7)
Weak eyesight (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

by_area.personality: Narrow-minded, hard-hearted, mischievous (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); wickedly disposed (Brihat Jataka 20.5).
by_area.finance: High spending on comfort, travel or others (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: Weak eyes (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); sleep and dreams are central themes (PanchangBodh).
by_area.spirituality: Linked to retreat, release and moksha; a waxing Moon makes a contemplative chart rather than a defeated one (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Waxing Moon (PanchangBodh)
Bhattotpala reads benefics in the 12th as reducing expenditure (Brihat Jataka 20.10 notes)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Waning Moon with Saturn: sloth and lethargy (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Sastri's note to Brihat Jataka: the Moon is bad in the 12th
placement_entries.disagreements: The classics and Raman are uniformly negative; Jataka Parijata (as legible) only mentions life abroad; the modern sites read it as an inward, creative or spiritual placement.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe a private, inward and imaginative nature that needs rest and solitude to recharge, possibly drawn to life abroad or spiritual retreat. Avoid words like miserable, wicked or deformed, and do not imply depression.

placement_entries.summary: The Moon in Sagittarius is in Jupiter's sign (neutral). It gives an articulate, principled, energetic and independent mind, inclined to poetry, arts and dharma, that responds to persuasion rather than force.
common_outcomes: Good speaker or writer; poetic gift
Energetic, confident, knows right conduct
Responds to conciliation, not pressure
Some friction with relatives
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka 17.9: wealth from the father; inclination to renunciation
Saravali 23.58: lives near water; knows secrets
Phaladeepika 9.9: favoured by rulers; defeats enemies

by_area.personality: Vigorous, self-confident, knows dharma (Brihat Jataka 17.9); courageous, grateful, attached to kin (Saravali 23.58); deep and inventive intellect, upright, yielding to praise but inflexible to threats (Raman HPA ch. XXII).
by_area.career: Poet, speaker and artist (Brihat Jataka 17.9); knows arts and secret matters (Saravali 23.58); Raman: author, patron of arts and literature.
by_area.finance: Wealth through the father (Brihat Jataka 17.9); Raman: good inheritance and unexpected gifts.
by_area.relationships: Responds to kindness rather than force (Phaladeepika 9.9); Raman: help from the wife, happy marriage.
by_area.family: Brihat Jataka 17.9: at odds with relatives; Saravali 23.58: attached to kin; Raman: many children.
by_area.spirituality: Knows dharma and leans toward renunciation (Brihat Jataka 17.9); Raman: ceremonial-minded and reflective.

strengtheners: Strong sign lord (Jupiter): Saravali 23.88 says the Moon-sign results come to pass fully only when the Moon, its sign and that sign's lord are strong
Sun's or Mars's aspect (Saravali 23.59-64: high status, command and wealth)
Jupiter's aspect (Saravali 23.59-64: ministerial rank)
Saturn's aspect (Saravali 23.59-64: eloquence and royal favour)
Bright (waxing, well-lit) Moon, which Braha (pp. 19-20) treats as benefic and stronger
weakeners_or_cancellations: Waning or dim Moon, which Braha (pp. 19-20) treats as malefic and weaker
Weak sign lord (Jupiter); Saravali 23.88 makes full results depend on the lord's strength
Placement in a dusthana (6th, 8th, 12th); Braha (pp. 51-52) says a planet there is spoiled, the 6th being the mildest
placement_entries.disagreements: Brihat Jataka says at odds with relatives while Saravali says attached to kin. Other features agree.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as an articulate, principled, freedom-loving mind. Avoid predicting family conflict.
sources: Brihat Jataka 17.9 (tr. M. D. Neely, 2007)

placement_entries.summary: Mars in the 12th is read as a draining placement: losses and expenses, trouble in marriage, heat-related ailments, eye trouble and exposure to deception. It is a Kuja dosha house.
common_outcomes: Loss of money or lack of wealth (Jataka Parijata 8.97; Raman)
Trouble or loss in marriage (Phaladeepika 8.10, Jataka Parijata 8.97; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Defective eyes (Phaladeepika 8.10; Raman HPA)
Liable to fraud and deception (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Slanderous, cruel or base (Phaladeepika 8.10)
Diseases from excess bodily heat (Raman)
Work abroad, in institutions, or disciplined spiritual practice (PanchangBodh)

by_area.personality: Selfish and hateful (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); odious to others (Jataka Parijata 8.97).
by_area.career: Unsuccessful (Raman HPA); suits work abroad and institutional settings (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Without wealth (Jataka Parijata 8.97); energy and money spent in distant or unseen places such as travel, legal or medical costs (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: Heat-related ailments (Raman); restless sleep (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Classical texts give loss of or no spouse (Phaladeepika 8.10, Jataka Parijata 8.97); malefics in the 7th and 8th with Mars here suggest a second marriage (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.spirituality: Disciplined spiritual practice suits it (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Kuja dosha does not arise when the 12th is Taurus or Libra, or when Mars is in Leo or Aquarius (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Conjunction with Jupiter or the Moon counters Kuja dosha (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Aspected by the Sun: danger from fire and wicked people (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Mars in the 12th, Saturn in the 2nd, Moon in the lagna and Sun in the 7th: a skin disorder (leucoderma) (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
placement_entries.disagreements: VedicFeed reads it as kind and peaceful, against the uniformly negative classics and Raman. PanchangBodh frames the 12th as a place for foreign work and spiritual discipline rather than mere loss.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as energy that works best behind the scenes, abroad or in disciplined practice; advise budgeting and care with trust in money matters. Do not predict loss of a spouse, and keep health notes general.

placement_entries.summary: Mars in Sagittarius is in Jupiter's sign, a friend. Texts describe a well-known, fearless fighter or minister with many opponents, who works hard but can lose gains through anger.
common_outcomes: Fearless and well known
Advisory, ministerial or command roles
Many rivals or opponents
Hard-working; temper can cost gains
rare_outcomes: Saravali 25.17-18: commander of chariots and armies; disrespects elders
Brihat Jataka 18.7: few sons

by_area.personality: Harsh-spoken and crafty, loses happiness and money through anger (Saravali 25.17-18); fearless (Brihat Jataka 18.7); open, frank, impatient, severe and quarrelsome (Raman HPA ch. XXII).
by_area.career: Royal minister, well known (Brihat Jataka 18.7); warrior commanding armies (Saravali 25.17-18); Raman: minister, statesman.
by_area.finance: Saravali 25.17-18: loses money through anger.
by_area.relationships: Many enemies (Brihat Jataka 18.7; Raman), and Raman adds litigation troubles.
by_area.family: Few sons (Brihat Jataka 18.7; Raman); does not honour elders (Saravali 25.17-18).

strengtheners: Sun's aspect (Saravali 25.55-60: honoured widely, fortunate)
Mercury's aspect (Saravali 25.55-60: scholar)
Venus's aspect (Saravali 25.55-60: popular, charitable, fortunate)
Kendra or trikona placement; Braha (p. 50) says planets in kendras are powerful and those in trikonas flourish
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon's aspect (Saravali 25.55-60: combative, opposed to authorities)
Saturn's aspect (Saravali 25.55-60: restlessness, unhappiness)
Jupiter's aspect (Saravali 25.55-60: wealth but domestic strain)
placement_entries.disagreements: Brihat Jataka gives ministerial rank and fame; Saravali focuses on combat and anger. Both agree on courage and opposition.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as courageous, principled drive with a need to manage temper. Avoid injury or child-related predictions.

placement_entries.summary: Mercury in the lagna is one of the best-agreed placements: every text read describes a learned, intelligent and pleasant-spoken person, and several add long life.
common_outcomes: Learned, intelligent, quick-witted (Phaladeepika, Saravali, Brihat Jataka, Jataka Parijata, Raman)
Sweet, skilful or clever speech (Phaladeepika 8.11; Saravali 30.38; Bhrigu Sutras)
Skill in poetry and mathematics; knows the right time and place (Saravali 30.38)
Humour, adaptability, wide reading (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Long life (Phaladeepika 8.11; Saravali 30.38)
Interest in mantra, tantra, occult study or astrology (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17; Raman)
Earns by writing; good as a physician; protects against other planets' longevity threats (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)
Pilgrimage in the 27th year (Bhrigu Sutras; Adawal); state as a text detail only

by_area.personality: Quick wit, mental ingenuity, humour, adaptability (Raman); quick, curious, youthful temperament (PanchangBodh); kind and forgiving (Bhrigu Sutras).
by_area.career: Earning through writing; aptitude for medicine (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary); scholarship (Jataka Parijata 8.58).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth with academic distinction (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17); devoted to acquiring wealth as well as learning (Jataka Parijata 8.58).
by_area.health: Good health when Mercury is with benefics; skin, bile or jaundice trouble when with malefics (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17); nervous trouble if Rahu or Ketu share the lagna (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Early marriage (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17); its 7th aspect brings talkative intelligence into partnership (PanchangBodh).
by_area.family: Happiness from brothers when Mercury is exalted or in own sign (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17).
by_area.spirituality: Listens devoutly to scripture, inclined to virtue and religion (Bhrigu Sutras; Jataka Parijata 8.58); learned in shastras (Phaladeepika 8.11).

strengtheners: Exalted or own sign: Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full (exaltation) through 3/4 (moolatrikona) and 1/2 (own sign) down to little in enemy signs
In a kendra in Gemini or Virgo it forms Bhadra Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Directional strength (digbala) in the 1st (PanchangBodh)
Good aspect from Venus gives musical and artistic talent (Raman)
Benefic association: health, wealth, grain, skill in logic and arithmetic (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 14 deg (12 deg retrograde)
Debilitation in Pisces (Brihat Jataka 20.11 scale; Bhrigu Sutras)
Mercury turns malefic when joined or aspected by malefics (Bhrigu Sutras commentary on house 1)
Rahu or Ketu in the lagna with Mercury: nervous troubles (Raman)
Saturn conjunction: trouble to the left eye (Bhrigu Sutras 13)
placement_entries.disagreements: Little real disagreement. Bhrigu Sutras 5-8 oddly list a defective limb, eye trouble and quarrels with brothers even under benefic influence; its own commentator rejects this. VedicFeed alone stresses scattered attention and inattentiveness as the downside.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Lead with mind and voice: curious, articulate, quick to learn. Treat long-life statements as traditional praise, never as a lifespan claim; mention nervous restlessness only as something to manage.

placement_entries.summary: Mercury in Capricorn (Makara), Saturn's earth sign and neutral for Mercury, gives a practical, cautious and work-focused intellect; classical texts are largely unfavourable, describing work for others, hardship, debt and timidity.
common_outcomes: Does work on behalf of others or in subordinate roles
Practical, methodical thinking; some artistic skill
Periods of financial strain or debt
Worry or restless sleep
rare_outcomes: Saravali mentions gossip and untruthfulness
Brihat Jataka 18.11 (Mercury in a Saturn sign) adds forced labour or obligations

by_area.personality: Saravali 26.19-20: timid and dull; restless dreams and wandering.
by_area.career: Brihat Jataka 18.11 (Sastri): does others' work, sculptural work, works as a labourer. Saravali 26.19-20: does others' work.
by_area.finance: Both texts mention poverty or debt; steady saving and caution with loans are relevant.
by_area.family: Saravali mentions being without the support of relatives.

strengtheners: Saravali 26.61-66 (Capricorn/Aquarius group): Jupiter's aspect gives abundant money and grain, honour and fame; Mars' aspect gives calm and happiness; Sun's aspect gives great strength, sweet speech and fame
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (navamsa section): a vargottama planet gives results like a planet in its own sign
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 26.61-66: Saturn's aspect gives poverty and misery; Venus' aspect gives an unsuitable spouse and strong passions

James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (Sun and 'Combustion' sections): a planet within about 8 degrees of the Sun is combust and its significations and the houses it rules are spoiled; Raman (Budha-Aditya Yoga) suggests Mercury may partly escape this
placement_entries.disagreements: Classical texts agree on an unfavourable tone. BPHS and Braha both treat Saturn as neutral to Mercury, so Capricorn is a neutral sign; claims online that Saturn is Mercury's friend are not supported by these sources.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Frame as a methodical, hardworking mind that may carry responsibility for others and should avoid unnecessary debt. Do not label the person dull or dishonest; avoid fatalistic statements about poverty.
sources: Saravali 26.19-20 (tr. R. Santhanam)

placement_entries.summary: Jupiter in the 4th is consistently read as happiness at home: family, mother, friends, property, conveyances and contentment, often with learning and religious leaning.
common_outcomes: Happy (Brihat Jataka 20.7; Phaladeepika 8.14; Bhrigu Sutras 19-23; Raman)
Happiness with mother, friends, spouse, children, attendants (Phaladeepika 8.14)
Relatives, conveyances, wealth, comforts (Saravali 30.53; Jataka Parijata 8.69)
Land and property (Bhrigu Sutras 19-23; PanchangBodh)
rare_outcomes: Crafty disposition (Jataka Parijata 8.69)
Enemies act like servants, yet not contented (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)
Gajakesari Yoga if joined by the Moon (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)

by_area.personality: Wise, of good conduct, highly intelligent (Bhrigu Sutras 19-23); philosophically inclined, learned (Raman); eloquent (Jataka Parijata 8.69); comfort can breed complacency (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Favour of the ruling class (Raman); gains in property and vehicles (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Wealth, grain, conveyances (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.53); landlord (Bhrigu Sutras 19-23).
by_area.relationships: A source of misery to enemies (Saravali 30.53); terror to enemies (Raman).
by_area.family: Happiness with mother and family (Phaladeepika 8.14); respected mother (PanchangBodh); peaceful domestic life (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Religious inclination and great spiritual advancement (Raman); home as a place of learning or worship (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Strong 4th lord, or Venus or Moon association, or benefic vargas: many lands and a spacious house (Bhrigu Sutras 20)
With the Moon: Gajakesari Yoga (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Well fortified: prosperity in all 4th-house matters and a peaceful home (Raman)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
Aspected or joined by a malefic: no land or conveyance, living in others' houses, bitterness with relatives (Bhrigu Sutras 21-23)
Afflicted: hardships and obstacles (Raman)
placement_entries.disagreements: Little classical disagreement. Jataka Parijata 8.69 adds 'crafty' and Chamatkar Chintamani 'not contented'; VedicFeed alone suggests strain with the mother.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Speak of a peaceful, values-centred home and inner contentment. Property and vehicles can be mentioned as traditional indications, not promises.

placement_entries.summary: Jupiter in Aries (Mesha), the fire sign of its friend Mars, gives energetic, assertive wisdom: leadership, effort-driven prosperity and a strong sense of justice, with a tendency toward argument, enemies and heavy expenditure.
common_outcomes: Gains wealth, ornaments and status through personal effort
Prominent or respected profession; capable of leading
Argumentative; attracts rivals or opponents
Generous and forgiving despite a forceful manner
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka 18.12 (Jupiter in a Mars sign): commander of an army, gains through the spouse, famous
Saravali 27.1-2 says the native may impose severe punishments (read as a strict, rule-enforcing role)

by_area.personality: Saravali 27.1-2: argumentative and splendorous. Brihat Jataka 18.12 (Sastri): forgiving, brave and generous.
by_area.career: Saravali 27.1-2: an eminent and famous profession. Brihat Jataka 18.12: head of an army.
by_area.finance: Wealth and ornaments through effort; Saravali warns of heavy expenses.
by_area.health: Saravali mentions risk of bodily injury; do not convert into a health prediction.
by_area.relationships: Brihat Jataka 18.12: many wives and children (Sastri); good qualities gained through the spouse (Neely).
by_area.family: Saravali and Brihat Jataka both mention children.

strengtheners: Friendly sign (Phaladeepika 3.18: 'delighted')

Saravali 27.25-30 (Aries/Scorpio group): Sun's aspect makes the native charitable, truthful and fortunate with famous children; Moon's aspect gives a writer of history and poetry, gems and learning; Mars' aspect gives high birth, valour and political knowledge; Venus' aspect gives comforts of home, dress and spouse
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (navamsa section): a vargottama planet gives results like a planet in its own sign
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 27.25-30: Mercury's aspect makes the native crafty and fault-finding; Saturn's aspect brings untidiness, miserliness and no lasting children or friendships; Mars' aspect, though favourable, adds a disobedient spouse and servants
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (rules of interpretation): planets in kendras are powerful, in trikonas enhanced, in the 6th, 8th or 12th spoiled
placement_entries.disagreements: Both texts agree on leadership and wealth; Saravali adds enemies, expense and injury risk that Brihat Jataka omits. The two Brihat Jataka translations differ on the spouse: Sastri has 'many wives', Neely 'gains good qualities through the spouse'.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as principled, energetic leadership and effort-based success. Mention rivals and expenses as things to manage, not as threats. No injury predictions.

placement_entries.summary: Venus in the 3rd is widely read as a weak placement: stinginess, lack of luck or courage and domination by the spouse are common themes, though Saravali still calls the person happy and rich and modern writers stress charm and artistic expression.
common_outcomes: Stingy or miserly (Phaladeepika 8.17; Brihat Jataka 20.8 read with 20.7; Bhrigu Sutras 20-22)
Dominated by or 'conquered by' women or the spouse (Saravali 30.64; Jataka Parijata 8.66)
Unhappy, poor or unfortunate (Phaladeepika 8.17; Saravali 30.64)
Delight in music, singing, dance and fine arts (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Without a wife (Phaladeepika 8.17)
Happy and rich, though unlucky and unenthusiastic (Saravali 30.64)
Sorrow, disease and danger, unless Venus is an evening star ahead of the Sun (Jataka Parijata 8.67)
Success through determined effort; brothers decrease over time (Bhrigu Sutras 20-22)

by_area.personality: Fretful in speech (Jataka Parijata 8.66); not courageous (Saravali 30.64; Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary); likeable negotiator (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Writing, music, performance, media, photography, decoration (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Financially not very successful (Raman); poor (Phaladeepika 8.17); Saravali instead says rich.
by_area.health: Health poor, lacking vitality, though the mind is good (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Unpopular (Phaladeepika 8.17); spouse dominates (Saravali 30.64).
by_area.family: Good brothers (Raman); affectionate siblings, especially sisters (PanchangBodh); strong 3rd lord increases brothers, afflicted 3rd lord loses them (Bhrigu Sutras 20-22); little happiness from children (Raman).

strengtheners: Exalted (Pisces) or own sign (Taurus, Libra): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly makes the best results depend on dignity or benefic company
In a kendra in Taurus, Libra or Pisces it forms Malavya Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Venus as an evening star (ahead of the Sun) turns benefic here (Jataka Parijata 8.67)
Strong 3rd lord, in own or exaltation sign: more siblings (Bhrigu Sutras 21)
Upachaya house: results improve with age (PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Virgo or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 4, 32, 40)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 10 deg (8 deg retrograde)
Afflicted: miserly, mean, poor, highly sensual, drawn to scandal (Raman)
3rd lord in a dusthana or with malefics: loss of siblings (Bhrigu Sutras 22)
placement_entries.disagreements: Saravali 30.64 calls the person happy and rich yet unlucky; Phaladeepika 8.17 says poor, unhappy and without a wife. Raman and PanchangBodh emphasise artistic expression. Jataka Parijata 8.67 alone gives the evening-star exception. The Bhrigu Sutras commentator concludes no classic treats it as good.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as artistic, diplomatic expression and warm sibling ties, with advice to build courage and follow-through. Avoid 'no spouse' or 'poor' predictions.
