placement_entries.summary: Venus in Pisces (Meena) is exalted, deepest at 27 degrees: love, beauty and generosity are at their most refined and devotional. Texts describe a courteous, generous, learned, wealthy and honoured person who keeps promises; Malavya Yoga if in a kendra.
common_outcomes: Courteous, generous, virtuous and eloquent
Very wealthy and fortunate
Honoured by authorities; famous and distinguished
Keeps promises and supports family
rare_outcomes: Saravali 28.23-24: defeats enemies
Malavya Mahapurusha Yoga in a kendra (Phaladeepika 6.1, 6.3)

by_area.personality: Saravali 28.23-24: courteous, liberal, virtuous, good speech and wisdom.
by_area.career: Saravali 28.23-24: dear to the ruler, famous and distinguished. Brihat Jataka 18.16: learned, honoured by the sovereign.
by_area.finance: Strongly favourable (Saravali: very wealthy).
by_area.relationships: Foss (name 2): love can turn into deep devotion and unconditional acceptance. Saravali: keeps promises.
by_area.family: Supports family (Saravali).
by_area.spirituality: Foss (names 2, 9, 51): exalted Venus is about purity and devotion rather than artistry or wealth, and brings out Venus' most spiritual qualities.

strengtheners: Exaltation at 27 degrees Pisces (BPHS 3.49-50); Phaladeepika 3.18: an exalted planet is 'blazing'; Braha: Venus operates best in Pisces
Malavya Yoga in a kendra (Phaladeepika 6.1, 6.3; Raman no. 20)
Saravali 28.55-60 (Sagittarius/Pisces group): Moon's aspect gives fame and distinction; Mercury's aspect gives great wealth and happiness; Saturn's aspect gives steady gains
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (navamsa section): a vargottama planet gives results like a planet in its own sign
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 28.55-60: Mars' aspect gives mixed happiness
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (navamsa section): a planet exalted in the birth chart but debilitated in the navamsa gives very mixed results

James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (Sun and 'Combustion' sections): a planet within about 8 degrees of the Sun is combust and its significations and the houses it rules are spoiled
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (rules of interpretation): planets in kendras are powerful, in trikonas enhanced, in the 6th, 8th or 12th spoiled
placement_entries.disagreements: None on dignity. Emphasis differs: Saravali and Brihat Jataka stress wealth, honour and learning, while Foss says exalted Venus is not about wealth or artistry but devotion. The 27-degree exaltation point rests on reading the BPHS word-code 'bhamita' as 27. Saravali 28.55-60 in Santhanam's translation gives only five aspect results (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Saturn); it has no statement for Jupiter's aspect on Venus in Sagittarius or Pisces.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe refined, generous and devotional love and good fortune as supported tendencies, still dependent on house, aspects and dasha. Avoid absolute promises of wealth or fame.

placement_entries.summary: Saturn in the 12th is classically adverse: expenses and losses, low standing or opposition, and eye or limb troubles; benefic association, dignity, or Saturn ruling a dusthana can turn it towards foreign success, thrift and spiritual practice.
common_outcomes: Heavy or wasteful expenditure, poverty, trade losses (Phaladeepika 8.24; Saravali 30.85; Bhrigu Sutras 49-53; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Defective eyesight (Saravali 30.85; Bhrigu Sutras 49-53; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
A defect in some limb or body part (Phaladeepika 8.24; Bhrigu Sutras 49-53; Raman HJH)
Enemies, insult or loss of standing (Phaladeepika 8.24; Brihat Jataka via 20.3; Saravali 30.85; Raman HJH)
rare_outcomes: Learning in occult science and attraction to yoga in later life (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Happiness in foreign travel (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras); success in remote foreign lands if Saturn is dignified (Braha)
Chamatkar Chintamani: as lagna lord in the 12th, destroys enemies
Bhrigu Sutras 49-53: with a benefic, happiness, good eyesight and a good after-life; with a malefic, the reverse

by_area.personality: Talkative, unkind or shameless in the classical lists (Saravali 30.85); pessimist (Raman HJH); dexterous (Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.career: Not favourable for a steady career (Braha); losses in trade (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.finance: Cannot hold on to wealth (Braha); spends much (Saravali 30.85); wasteful expenditure with a malefic (Bhrigu Sutras 49-53).
by_area.health: Eye trouble (Saravali; Bhrigu Sutras; Raman HJH); left eye/ear or foot complaints (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Little sexual pleasure, sleeps on hard beds (Braha).
by_area.family: Without children (Phaladeepika 8.24).
by_area.spirituality: Attracted towards yoga in later life (Hindu Predictive Astrology); dignified Saturn gives success in pursuing higher consciousness (Braha).

strengtheners: Association with a benefic (Bhrigu Sutras 49-53)
Saturn as lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th in the 12th: very beneficial (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Saturn in Libra, Capricorn or Aquarius: retains wealth, spends wisely, succeeds abroad (Braha)
Saturn as lagna lord in the 12th: destroys enemies (Chamatkar Chintamani)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Association with a malefic: poor eyesight, waste, poverty (Bhrigu Sutras 49-53)
Saturn as lord of an auspicious house: that house's matters suffer (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Saturn in Aries: debts, little success abroad (Braha)
placement_entries.disagreements: Sources agree on the difficult core; Hindu Predictive Astrology and Braha add a spiritual or foreign-success upside that the older classics (Phaladeepika, Saravali) do not mention.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Frame as a call for budgeting and for meaningful solitude, retreat or service abroad. Do not predict poverty, disability or after-death states.

placement_entries.summary: Saturn in Sagittarius is in Jupiter's sign, neutral to Saturn. Classical texts are favourable: skill in teaching and sacred learning, fame through good children and family, few words, and wealth in old age. Foss and Braha both say Saturn does especially well in Jupiter's signs.
common_outcomes: Trusted position with authorities; good children, spouse and wealth (Brihat Jataka 18.19)
Skill in conduct, teaching and the meaning of sacred texts (Saravali 29.17-18)
Fame through virtuous children, family profession and own virtues; affluence in old age (Saravali 29.17-18)
Raman's dasa note: philosophical and religious study and peace (HPA ch.24)
rare_outcomes: Saravali 29.17-18 says speaks little and has many names
Saravali 29.59: Jupiter aspect makes one a king, minister or army chief; 29.58: Mercury aspect a respected preceptor; 29.57: Mars aspect is unfavourable
Brihat Jataka 18.19: leadership of a town, army or village

by_area.personality: Speaks little, soft in disposition (Saravali 29.17-18); Raman: peaceful, faithful, courteous, sometimes pretentious (HPA ch.22).
by_area.career: Teaching and sacred learning (Saravali 29.17-18); leading a town or group (Brihat Jataka 18.19).
by_area.finance: Excellent affluence in old age (Saravali 29.17-18).
by_area.relationships: Brihat Jataka 18.19 gives a good spouse; Raman notes troubles with wife (HPA ch.22).
by_area.family: Fame through virtuous children and family profession (Saravali 29.17-18); dutiful children (Raman HPA ch.22).
by_area.spirituality: Study of philosophy and religion (Raman HPA ch.24).

strengtheners: Jupiter or Mercury aspect (Saravali 29.58-59)
Foss and Braha: Saturn is most auspicious in Jupiter's signs despite Jupiter being only neutral to it
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars aspect (Saravali 29.57)
Phaladeepika 9.19: a neutral sign gives no marked change by itself
placement_entries.disagreements: Classical verses and modern authors (Foss, Braha) are positive although the dignity is only neutral. Raman notes marital trouble that Brihat Jataka does not.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe as earned trust and principled leadership that matures over time. Avoid guaranteeing children or wealth.

placement_entries.summary: Rahu in the 3rd, an upachaya house, is one of its best placements: courage, initiative, strong will, wealth and long life, at the cost of harmony with siblings.
common_outcomes: Courageous, bold, strong-willed (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Braha)
Wealth and long life (Phaladeepika 8.25; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Strained relations with, or few, siblings (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Braha)
Fulfilment of efforts and desires (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Abundance of oilseeds/produce (Bhrigu Sutras 7-8); with a benefic, a mark on the neck
Severe criticism for one's views; sudden, unexpected news (Raman HJH)
Gymnastic or physical skill; many relations (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Talent in organising, writing, music or drama (Braha)

by_area.personality: Proud, strong-willed (Phaladeepika 8.25); 'brave for outward appearances' (Raman HJH); adventurous, excited, motivated (Braha).
by_area.career: Ability in organisational or detail work, communication, fine arts; Gemini/Virgo may give work as a producer or director (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.25); very wealthy (Hindu Predictive Astrology); favours wealth and respect (Braha).
by_area.health: Long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.25; Braha).
by_area.family: Hostile to brothers (Phaladeepika 8.25); generally bad for brothers (Raman HJH); few younger siblings or no happiness from them (Braha); few children (Hindu Predictive Astrology).

strengtheners: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th aspected by benefics destroys all evils (Saravali 12.3-5); counteracts other negative combinations (Raman HJH)
Malefics in upachaya houses give good results (Uttara Kalamrita 4.16; Braha)
Rahu in Gemini or Virgo: greater courage, artistic and communicative excellence (Braha)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Bhrigu Sutras 7-8 gives only a neutral or minor result, so the strong positive reading rests on Phaladeepika and later authors
Sibling matters remain the weak point even when Rahu is strong (Braha)
placement_entries.disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. Phaladeepika, Raman, Braha and Saravali 12 agree that the 3rd is good for Rahu; the Bhrigu Sutras give only a minor material result. Uttara Kalamrita 4.9 omits the 3rd from Rahu's good houses.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: A confident placement to describe: initiative, nerve and success through one's own efforts and communication. Mention sibling relationships as needing care, without predicting estrangement.

placement_entries.summary: Rahu in Pisces is in Jupiter's sign. Jataka Bharanam's main view gives Pisces as Rahu's moolatrikona, but most lists treat it as neutral. Raman calls Rahu's dasa from Pisces mixed and stresses checking friendly or unfriendly placement and house.
common_outcomes: Raman's dasa note: mixed results, with fear of swindlers, some gains, educational progress and unease (HPA ch.24)
Strong pull to the mystical and imaginative; escapism risk (astromedha.in, via summary)
rare_outcomes: Jataka Bharanam main view: Pisces is Rahu's moolatrikona

by_area.finance: Some gains with risk from swindlers (Raman HPA ch.24).
by_area.relationships: Inclination to marriage in Rahu's dasa (Raman HPA ch.24).
by_area.spirituality: Very prominent; discernment is key (astromedha.in, via summary).

strengtheners: Strong Jupiter (dispositor; Frawley pp.256-257); Raman (HPA ch.15) says the nodes do well in benefics' signs
weakeners_or_cancellations: Weak or afflicted Jupiter (Frawley pp.256-257)
Frawley: the nodes in water signs tend to negate the water element (p.115)
placement_entries.disagreements: Moolatrikona (Jataka Bharanam main view) vs neutral (most lists). Pisces is Ketu's own sign in Jataka Bharanam and Bhavartha Ratnakara, which some read as uncomfortable for Rahu. Raman explicitly calls the results mixed.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Highlight imagination, compassion and spiritual interest; mention escapism only as something to ground. No mental-health predictions.

placement_entries.summary: Ketu in the 9th is classically adverse for fortune, righteousness and the father; modern readings add short temper and haughtiness but also valour, thrift and a good spouse, with fortune restored when Ketu is well placed.
common_outcomes: Misfortune or ill luck (Phaladeepika 8.32; Braha)
Strain with or loss of the father (Phaladeepika 8.32; Braha); poor treatment of parents (Raman HJH)
Unrighteous conduct or slandering the good in classical lists (Phaladeepika 8.32; Bhrigu Sutras 24; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Foss name 57)
Little interest in philosophy or religion (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Wealth earned with the help of foreigners; anxious for children (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Good spouse and children; many children (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Eloquent, valorous, fond of pomp; saves money through frugality (Raman HJH)
Bhrigu Sutras 24: childless, dependent livelihood

by_area.personality: Short-tempered, upset by trifles, haughty but valorous, eloquent (Raman HJH); narrow-minded (Braha); untruthful, thrifty (Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.finance: Indigent (Phaladeepika 8.32); frugal and saves much (Raman HJH); wealth via foreigners (Chamatkar Chintamani).
by_area.health: Short-sighted (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.relationships: Good wife (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.family: Deprived of the father (Phaladeepika 8.32); hostile to parents (Raman HJH); difficulties with a father whose life may be troubled (Braha); good children (Raman HJH).
by_area.spirituality: Foss: Ketu here may indicate religious extremism or experiencing 'papa' (demerit), though he softens the term.

strengtheners: Ketu in Gemini or Virgo: benefit from a fine father, luck, good morals (Braha)
Trikona placement connected with a kendra/trikona lord (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52)
Node in the 9th or 10th with a trikona lord gives prosperity (Uttara Kalamrita, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Node in a trikona associated with the 2nd or 7th lord: harmful dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)
placement_entries.disagreements: Classical support for Ketu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no node results by house; Phaladeepika 8.28-33 is the main classical per-house statement, the Bhrigu Sutras give a single combined result for Rahu or Ketu, and the rest are scattered rules (Uttara Kalamrita, BPHS, Jataka Parijata) or later/modern readings. Raman HJH and Hindu Predictive Astrology give a good spouse and (many) children, while the Bhrigu Sutras give childlessness; Chamatkar Chintamani is mildly positive financially.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe an independent, sometimes sceptical relationship with tradition, teachers and the father, and a fortune built through one's own choices. Avoid moral judgments and statements about the father's death.

placement_entries.summary: Ketu in Virgo has contested dignity: Braha and Frawley's second view make Mercury's signs the exaltation of both nodes, Wikipedia says Ketu co-rules Virgo, and BPHS lists Virgo among Ketu's favourable signs; in Jataka Bharanam's main view Virgo is Rahu's own sign instead. Raman's dasa note is one of his harshest.
common_outcomes: Braha: either node flourishes in Virgo
Raman's dasa note: risks, losses and loss of self-respect (HPA ch.24)
Precise, detached analysis and perfectionism (astromedha.in, via summary)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 45.135: Virgo among signs where Ketu in shayana avastha brings wealth

by_area.personality: Exacting and self-critical (astromedha.in, via summary).
by_area.finance: Wealth even in a weak state (BPHS 45.135).

strengtheners: Strong Mercury (dispositor; Frawley p.258)
Braha: the nodes do better in the 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th; Frawley instead counts the 3rd, 6th and 8th difficult for Ketu and the 12th good
weakeners_or_cancellations: Afflicted Mercury (Frawley p.258)
placement_entries.disagreements: Exaltation for both nodes (Braha, Frawley's second view) or co-rulership (Wikipedia) vs Virgo as Rahu's own sign (Jataka Bharanam main view) vs neutral. Bhavartha Ratnakara 15.9 does not name Virgo for Ketu. Raman's dasa note is strongly negative.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Highlight precise analysis and service; frame perfectionism as something to relax. No digestive or nervous-system claims.

placement_entries.summary: The self is drawn toward expenditure, distance and withdrawal: classical texts warn of reduced comfort, heavy spending and anger unless benefics help; modern readers add foreign residence and spiritual inclination.
common_outcomes: high or uncontrolled expenses
living in a foreign land (Charak)
visits to holy places and charitable spending (Raman)
less physical ease unless benefics support
rare_outcomes: BPHS: wasteful spending and anger when no benefic aspect or conjunction

by_area.personality: Can be quick-tempered (BPHS 24.12); Rath 4.4.12: the cause of own misfortunes, short temper, a spendthrift.
by_area.career: Losses and little success in business enterprises unless fortified (Raman HTJH I); Charak: lives in a foreign land.
by_area.finance: Many losses (Raman); spending patterns follow the nature of the lagna and 12th lords (Rath 4.4.12); when strong, inherited riches are spent on charity (Raman).
by_area.health: Classical texts reduce bodily comfort (BPHS 12.1, 24.12; Charak); no medical predictions.
by_area.spirituality: Visits holy places; when well placed, emotionally balanced and dedicated to public welfare (Raman HTJH I).

strengtheners: benefic aspect or conjunction (BPHS 24.12 conditions the bad results on their absence)
lagna lord in own sign in the 12th (Aquarius lagna: Saturn in Capricorn) - lagna ownership predominates
Jupiter's aspect or a spiritually oriented D9 supports the moksha side
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic association without benefic aspect (BPHS 12.1, 24.12)
weak lord: Phaladeepika 15.9 says harm is severe when the lord is weak
debilitation: Libra lagna, Venus in Virgo
placement_entries.disagreements: Classical texts and Rath treat this as unfavourable; Raman gives a charitable, public-service expression when the lord is well placed; Charak names living in a foreign land, which BPHS 24.12 does not state.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe as a placement of giving, distance and inner life; suggest mindful spending. Avoid predicting isolation, loss or illness.

placement_entries.summary: Wealth falls into the house of loss and expenditure: savings are hard to keep, the person may rely on others' resources, and BPHS adds a traditional caution about the eldest child; benefic links can turn spending toward good causes.
common_outcomes: spending exceeds saving
money spent abroad or on family, charity or comforts
reliance on others' resources at times
rare_outcomes: BPHS traditional view: no happiness from the eldest child
BPHS 13.9: 2nd and 12th lords with benefics direct spending to dharmic causes

by_area.personality: Courageous or adventurous (BPHS 24.24; Charak: courageous, laborious); respectable (Raman HTJH I).
by_area.career: Government service and income through religious institutions (Raman); a natural-benefic 2nd lord makes a renowned trader (Charak).
by_area.finance: Main caution: wealth hard to keep (BPHS 24.24; Charak). Exchange of the 2nd and 12th lords, or the 2nd lord in the 12th with the 12th lord in the lagna aspected by a maraka, gives poverty (Bhavartha Ratnakara II, Nirdhana st. 2-3).
by_area.family: Traditional line about little happiness from the eldest child (BPHS 24.24; Charak) or from an elder brother (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Spending on religious causes when benefics are involved (BPHS 13.9); income through ecclesiastical sources (Raman).

strengtheners: exaltation: Aries lagna (Venus in Pisces) and Gemini lagna (Moon in Taurus)
benefic conjunction, turning expenditure toward good causes (BPHS 13.9)
strong lord limits loss (Phaladeepika 15.9)
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation: Aquarius lagna, Jupiter in Capricorn
11th lord also in a dusthana (BPHS 13.8)
malefic association
exchange of the 2nd and 12th lords: poverty (Bhavartha Ratnakara II, Nirdhana st. 2)
12th lord in the lagna aspected by a maraka at the same time: poverty (Bhavartha Ratnakara II, Nirdhana st. 3)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS renderings differ: 'depends on others' fortune' vs 'covets others' wealth'. Raman is milder (respectable, government service, ecclesiastical income). The family caution names the eldest child (BPHS, Charak) or an elder brother (Raman). Bhavartha Ratnakara exempts Aries lagna.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Advise mindful spending and saving; mention giving and foreign links positively. Do not predict poverty or problems with a child.

placement_entries.summary: Effort and courage are directed toward home and comfort: the person is happy, wealthy and intelligent, though BPHS adds a traditional caution about a difficult spouse.
common_outcomes: happiness and comforts at home
wealth and intelligence
learning (Raman)
some friction with the mother (Charak)
rare_outcomes: BPHS traditional view: a harsh or wicked spouse

by_area.personality: Content and clever (BPHS 24.28); learned (Raman; Charak: wise).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BPHS 24.28; Raman; Charak).
by_area.relationships: BPHS, Raman and Charak all carry a negative traditional line about the spouse; check the 7th house and Venus before saying anything.
by_area.family: Charak: at odds with the mother. Raman: a weak Mars can mean loss of lands and living in others' houses; brothers may outlive the native if the lagna and 9th lords are weak.

strengtheners: own sign: Scorpio lagna (Saturn in Aquarius, also 4th lord)
benefic aspects on the 4th; strong Moon
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation: Libra lagna, Jupiter in Capricorn
malefic affliction to the 4th
weak Mars: loss of lands and living in others' houses; the evil is reduced if the 3rd house is well disposed (Raman HTJH I)
placement_entries.disagreements: The spouse line appears in BPHS, Raman and Charak; it has no evident house logic. Charak's friction with the mother is not in BPHS 24.28.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Emphasise home comforts and wealth gained through effort. Do not characterise the spouse.
sources: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.28 (enjoylearningsanskrit.com)

placement_entries.summary: Home and comforts fall into the house of loss and distance: BPHS says domestic comforts are lacking, with bad habits, foolishness and idleness; modern readers stress living away from the birthplace or abroad.
common_outcomes: living away from birthplace or abroad (jagannathhora.com, practitioner site)
high home-related expenses
reduced domestic ease
need to guard against bad habits or inertia
rare_outcomes: BPHS traditional view: vices, foolishness and laziness

by_area.personality: Can drift toward indulgence or inertia (BPHS 24.48; Charak: foolish, indolent).
by_area.finance: Bad finances and loss of property (Raman HTJH I; 'Important Combinations': the 4th lord in a dusthana loses property); homelessness in Charak's list (traditional).
by_area.family: Little domestic happiness (BPHS 24.48; Raman); Charak says the father lives in a foreign land.
by_area.spirituality: Contemplative residence possible (jagannathhora.com, practitioner site).

strengtheners: exaltation: Taurus lagna (Sun in Aries) and Scorpio lagna (Saturn in Libra)
benefic aspect (Phaladeepika 15.5)
strong lord: injury is slight (Phaladeepika 15.9)
Cancer lagna: Venus as 4th and 11th lord gives yoga in the 12th or 2nd (Bhavartha Ratnakara I, Karkataka st. 3)
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation: Leo lagna, Mars in Cancer
malefic affliction; weak Moon
4th lord in a dusthana: loss of property and wealth (Raman HTJH I, 'Important Combinations')
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Charak are negative about home, property and character; Bhavartha Ratnakara makes an exception for Venus with Cancer lagna. Modern practitioners recast the placement as foreign residence, which BPHS 24.48 does not state; Charak puts the foreign land on the father.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Speak of finding home away from the birthplace and building good routines. Never call the person foolish or lazy.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of intelligence and children in the house of siblings and effort. BPHS and Raman read affection for siblings with a stingy, self-interested or tale-bearing streak; Braha reads courage and artistic or literary talent.
common_outcomes: Attached to siblings (BPHS 24.51); happiness from siblings (Braha); Raman: good brothers when favourable
Absorbed in one's own work (BPHS 24.51)
Talent in music, dance, drama or writing (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.51 and Raman both say stingy and a tale-bearer (traditional view; Raman ties it to an unfavourable lord)
Raman, unfavourable: concerns for children, misunderstandings with brothers and continuing occupational troubles

Phaladeepika 12.7 lists the 5th lord in the 3rd, together with a malefic in the lagna, the lagna lord in the 5th and the Moon in an odd sign in the 5th aspected by the Sun, as a combination for difficulty with children

by_area.personality: BPHS 24.51: intent on one's own work, but miserly and a tale-bearer. Braha: brave and adventurous.
by_area.career: Braha: talent in music, dance, drama and literature. Raman: continuing occupational troubles if unfavourable.
by_area.relationships: Attached to siblings (BPHS 24.51; Braha); misunderstandings with brothers if the lord is unfavourable (Raman).
by_area.family: Raman: many good children and brothers when favourable; concerns for children when unfavourable.

strengtheners: Raman: the lord favourably disposed gives many good children and brothers
Jupiter joining or aspecting the 5th lord (Bhavartha Ratnakara 4.19: birth of children is indicated)
The 5th lord a benefic and aspected by a benefic or placed in a benefic sign (Raman, 300 Combinations no. 231 Buddhimaturya: intelligence and good character)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Raman: unfavourable disposition brings the stingy, tale-bearing traits and trouble with brothers and work
Raman's 5th-house combinations: the 5th lord in the 3rd, 6th or 12th with no benefic aspect is listed among combinations for early loss concerning children (How to Judge a Horoscope p. 114)
The 5th lord debilitated, in an enemy sign, combust, or joined by the 6th, 8th or 12th lords (Phaladeepika 12.9: loss or grief concerning children)
Phaladeepika 12.7 combination (5th lord in 3rd plus malefic in lagna, lagna lord in 5th, Moon in odd sign in 5th aspected by the Sun)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS 24.51 and Raman describe stinginess and tale-bearing (Raman only for an unfavourable lord); Braha is wholly positive (courage, arts, sibling happiness). Raman also gives the children outcome both ways depending on the lord's condition.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Emphasise sibling bonds, effort and creative or communicative talent. Present the 'miserly or tale-bearer' line as a traditional caution, not a description.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of conflict, service and illness joins the self. BPHS gives a sickly but famous, wealthy and courageous person who is at odds with his own people; Raman and Bhavartha Ratnakara add trouble from cousins, while Raman also names military or penal careers when the lord is well aspected.
common_outcomes: Health and constitution need attention (BPHS 24.61; Braha; Bhavartha Ratnakara 5.1)
Friction with one's own people or cousins (BPHS 24.61; Bhavartha Ratnakara 5.1 with Raman's note)
Hard-working; drawn to army, prisons, medicine or healing (Raman; Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.61: also famous, rich, honourable, adventurous and virtuous
Raman: may live in the maternal uncle's house; a weak and afflicted lord is listed for criminal conduct (traditional view)
Braha: thin build, special diet, difficult start in life, no fame
Rath: the 6th lord in the lagna is in the 8th from the 6th, giving disease to enemies and good health to the native
Raman, 300 Combinations no. 265 Vrana yoga: a malefic 6th lord in the lagna, 8th or 10th is a classical combination for serious illness, which Raman says must not be applied literally

by_area.personality: Adventurous and virtuous but at odds with his own people (BPHS 24.61); Rath: inimical toward his own family and self.
by_area.career: Raman: well aspected, a soldier, commander, minister of war or prison official. Braha: hard worker, medical or healing arts.
by_area.finance: Rich (BPHS 24.61).
by_area.health: BPHS 24.61 and Bhavartha Ratnakara 5.1: sickly (traditional); Braha: poor health; Rath gives the opposite (good health to self).
by_area.relationships: Bhavartha Ratnakara 5.1: troubled by cousins; Raman's note adds worry from relatives' machinations.
by_area.family: Raman: lives in the maternal uncle's house; Braha: close to the maternal uncle, born to a common family.

strengtheners: Raman: the lord well aspected gives military or administrative authority
The lagna lord stronger than the 6th lord, in a benefic's sign or amsa and aspected by a benefic (Phaladeepika 16.17: health and comfort)
The 6th lord in a benefic's sign and aspected by benefics (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope p. 136: many friends)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Raman: weak and afflicted gives the criminal-conduct reading (traditional view)
Lagna lord in the lagna with the 6th, 8th or 12th lord (Raman, 300 Combinations no. 111 Rogagrastha: weak constitution)
Lagna lord and 6th lord both in the lagna, or the lagna lord in the 6th aspected by the 6th lord (Raman p. 136: trouble from relatives)
The 6th lord in a kendra joined or aspected by malefics (Phaladeepika 16.16; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope p. 136: constant trouble from enemies)
Phaladeepika 16.19: the house occupied by the 6th lord becomes a source of enmity for the native
placement_entries.disagreements: Health: BPHS, Bhavartha Ratnakara and Braha read a weaker constitution; Rath reads good health for the native and disease for enemies. Fame: BPHS says famous, Braha says no fame. Raman's career results (military, prisons) depend on the lord being well aspected.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Lead with resilience, discipline and a capacity for service. Mention health only as a matter of routine and self-care; no medical or moral claims.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of marriage in the house of loss, expense and the foreign. BPHS, Raman, Braha, Rath and Phaladeepika agree on less marital ease, spending and a partner of modest or different background; Raman and Bhavartha Ratnakara add more than one marriage. Rath makes an exception for Gemini and Virgo lagnas.
common_outcomes: Less happiness from the partner; separation possible (Braha; Raman; Phaladeepika 6.64)
Spending connected with the spouse; a frugal or close-fisted native (BPHS 24.84; Raman)
A spouse from a poorer or different background (Raman; Rath)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.84: livelihood related to clothes; an extravagant spouse
Raman and Bhavartha Ratnakara 6.3-6.4: more than one marriage, possibly a second marriage kept secret (traditional view)
Braha: a strong sexual nature (the 12th rules bed pleasures)
Raman: if both Venus and the 7th lord are weak, may only dream of marriage (traditional view)
Rath: for Gemini and Virgo, the 7th lord Jupiter is also the badhaka lord, and in the 12th it gives excellent results, its dasa marked by joy and prosperity

by_area.personality: Miserly (BPHS 24.84); close-fisted (Raman).
by_area.career: Livelihood related to clothes or textiles (BPHS 24.84).
by_area.finance: Penury (BPHS 24.84); generally poor (Raman); an extravagant spouse (BPHS 24.84).
by_area.relationships: No happiness from the partner, unsuccessful partnerships (Braha); separation (Raman); spouse from a poor family (Rath); a strong sexual nature (Braha).
by_area.family: Raman: the spouse may come from a servant's family (traditional view).

strengtheners: Benefic aspect on the 7th house (Phaladeepika 15.5)
Gemini or Virgo lagna with Jupiter as the 7th lord (Rath: excellent results)
The 7th lord or Venus joined or aspected by Jupiter or Mercury (Raman, 300 Combinations no. 239 Satkalatra: a noble, virtuous spouse)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Raman: severe affliction gives early separation; weak Venus and 7th lord together, no marriage
Venus in the 6th or debilitated as well (Bhavartha Ratnakara 6.3-6.4)
Phaladeepika 15.5: a house whose lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th suffers, unless a benefic aspects it
Rath (Crux 10.3.3): the 7th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th shows a spouse of different status or culture
Raman: the results must not be applied literally without judging the whole chart and the strength of every planet (How to Judge a Horoscope p. 171)
placement_entries.disagreements: Rath gives a lagna exception (Jupiter for Gemini and Virgo) that the other sources do not mention. The earlier note that modern authors stress foreign relocation is not supported by the sources read; it has been removed.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Do not predict loss of a spouse or a second marriage. Frame as a partnership that asks for patience and careful budgeting; mention the Gemini/Virgo exception only as a supportive factor.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of sudden change in the house of wealth, speech and family. BPHS, Raman and Braha agree on limited wealth, family discontent and eye, teeth or speech complaints; Braha adds that the lord aspecting its own house gives a long, active life.
common_outcomes: Modest wealth; lost wealth not regained (BPHS 24.86); poor (Braha)
Discontent and quarrels in family life; estrangement possible (Raman; Braha)
Eye, teeth, throat or speech complaints; poor food (Raman; Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.86: lacking bodily vigour (traditional note)
Braha: speaks untruths; limited education and imagination (traditional view)
Braha: a long and active life because the 8th lord aspects its own house from the 2nd

by_area.personality: Braha: a poor speaker, may speak lies (traditional view).
by_area.finance: Little wealth, lost wealth not regained (BPHS 24.86); poor (Braha).
by_area.health: Eye and tooth trouble (Raman); poor right-eye vision, throat problems (Braha). Traditional notes only.
by_area.relationships: The spouse may not understand the native; estrangement possible (Raman).
by_area.family: Discontent and quarrels at home (Raman); unhappy family life (Braha).

strengtheners: The 8th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope pp. 206-207: the evil is greatly reduced)
Saturn joining or aspecting the 8th lord (Bhavartha Ratnakara 7.2: long life)
Benefic aspect on the occupied house (Phaladeepika 15.5)
weakeners_or_cancellations: The 8th lord with the 2nd lord in the 2nd (Raman: troubles of all sorts)
Phaladeepika 15.5: a house occupied by the lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th suffers, unless a benefic aspects it

Raman: results must be modified by the strength of the lagna, the Moon and the running dasha; for indications of wrong conduct, a strong lagna, Moon and 10th mean the temptation is overcome (How to Judge a Horoscope p. 207)
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Advise careful money management and patient communication at home. Do not predict poverty or illness.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of fortune and dharma sits on the lagna, so luck, guidance and principled conduct become part of the person's own identity and body. Classically one of the most fortunate placements of any house lord.
common_outcomes: born fortunate: 'born with luck' (Braha); very fortunate (BPHS 24.97)
honour from rulers or people in authority (BPHS 24.97); drawn to public service (Rath Crux 12.9)
self-made: earns much through own efforts (Raman HTJH; Braha)
virtuous, learned and handsome, with a religious or principled nature (BPHS 24.97; Braha)
close, happy relationship with the father and a good start in life (Braha)
rare_outcomes: common in charts of saints and religious leaders; may head a religious organisation (Braha)
with the lagna lord also in the 1st and a benefic aspect: riches and happiness (Raman HTJH)
exalted 9th lord in the lagna, as in the chart of Sri Rama (Cancer lagna, Jupiter), forms a Lakshmi yoga in the lagna (Rath Crux 12.9; Frawley, Example Charts: Lord Rama)

by_area.personality: Virtuous, handsome, learned (BPHS 24.97); intelligent and well-bred (Rath Crux 12.9); born with wisdom and a strong life purpose (Braha).
by_area.career: Self-made, earns through own effort (Raman HTJH; Braha); interest in public service, since the 9th lord also stands for the ruler or government (Rath Crux 12.9).
by_area.finance: Earns much money through own efforts; fortunate with riches when joined by the lagna lord and aspected by a benefic (Raman HTJH).
by_area.health: Braha lists 'healthy' among the results; a general indication only.
by_area.family: Happy, close bond with the father (Braha). Rath notes that planets joining the 9th lord bring their own houses into the fortune story, e.g. the Moon joining it in Sri Rama's chart tied his fortune to his mothers (Crux 12.9).
by_area.spirituality: Religious, of great merit and faith; may head a religious organisation (Braha).

strengtheners: 9th lord strong in the lagna (a kendra) with the lagna aspected by its own lord: fortunes come in a crowd (JP 14.97)
lagna lord joined with it and a benefic aspect (Raman HTJH); lagna lord with the 9th lord and Jupiter in the 7th gives wealth and vehicles (BPHS 20.29)
exaltation, as in Sri Rama's chart (Rath Crux 12.9; Frawley, Example Charts)
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation with combustion of the 9th lord (BPHS 20.12 treats it as very weak for fortune)
Rath: planets conjoining the 9th lord draw their own houses into its results, and those houses should not be afflicted by malefics (Crux 12.9)
if the 9th lord also owns a dusthana (e.g. Saturn 8th+9th for Gemini, Jupiter 9th+12th for Aries, Mercury 9th+12th for Libra), both lordships act (BPHS 24.146-147)
placement_entries.disagreements: Little disagreement: BPHS, Raman, Braha and Rath are all favourable. Raman and Braha stress fortune that is self-made through effort, while BPHS stresses royal honour; Rath adds that the result depends on which planets join the 9th lord.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe as a supportive, blessed placement that shows good fortune through principled living and mentors. Avoid promising wealth or fame outright; note that the lord's dignity and the rest of the chart decide the scale.

placement_entries.summary: Career expressed through courage, communication and initiative; BPHS sees valour, eloquence and support from siblings and staff.
common_outcomes: happiness from siblings and servants; valorous, eloquent, truthful (BPHS 24.111)
constant short journeys for work (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4)
a speaker or writer of note if well placed; literary or communications career (Raman HTJH; Braha)
siblings help the career (Raman HTJH; Braha; Rath Crux 13.4)
career advances only through hard work and self-effort (Braha)
rare_outcomes: the 3rd is the 6th from the 10th, pointing to short-term service or contracts (Rath Crux 13.4)
with Venus associated, a job of constant travelling (Rath Crux 13.4)
career in music, dance or drama (Braha)

by_area.personality: Brave, eloquent, truthful (BPHS 24.111); courageous and adventurous (Braha).
by_area.career: Writing, speaking, communications or performing arts (Raman HTJH; Braha); travelling work and short-term contracts (Rath Crux 13.4).
by_area.family: Siblings advance the career (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4); rivalry between brothers can cause reversals if the 3rd lord is afflicted (Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: a well-placed 10th lord: a celebrated speaker or writer (Raman HTJH)
strength scales the result (BPHS 24.145-148)
weakeners_or_cancellations: 10th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna, or in an unfriendly nakshatra: a slow rise beset with obstacles (Raman HTJH)
afflicted 3rd lord: rivalry between brothers harms the career (Raman HTJH)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS is favourable. Raman adds a slow rise when the lord is weak in the navamsa, and Rath's 6th-from-the-10th reading points to short-term service or contracts rather than a steady post.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Emphasise initiative, communication skill and teamwork. Mention possible role changes as a growth pattern, not instability.

placement_entries.summary: The gains lord in the house of expenditure: gains tend to flow out, often to good causes, and the person may have strong desires and dealings with foreigners or outsiders.
common_outcomes: spends on good causes; strong desires; associates with outsiders (BPHS 24.132)
losses in business; frequent fines and penalties (Raman HTJH)
expenses on account of an elder sibling's troubles (Raman HTJH; Braha)
many financial losses and unfulfilled desires (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.132 says lustful with many wives; a traditional line, not to be used as character judgement
Phaladeepika's Daridra yoga as a traditional caution
with the 12th lord: losses through varied expenditure; in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna, debts (Raman HTJH, combinations)
comfortable bed pleasures (Braha)

by_area.personality: Strong desires (BPHS 24.132).
by_area.career: Business losses (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Gains flow out; fines and penalties (Raman HTJH); BPHS 22.11: in a trika house with malefics, gains fail despite effort.
by_area.relationships: Few or bad friends (Braha). Traditional texts link it with multiple relationships (BPHS 24.132); treat with great care.
by_area.family: Burdened with domestic responsibilities; expenses for an elder sibling (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Spending on good causes (BPHS 24.132).

strengtheners: strong lord (Phaladeepika 15.9); benefic aspect (15.5)
own-sign case: for Pisces lagna Saturn owns 11th and 12th and is in Aquarius here
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic association (BPHS 22.11)
malefics afflicting the 12th: wealth squandered (Raman HTJH, combinations)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS 24.132 includes spending on good causes alongside negative lines; Phaladeepika, Raman and Braha are wholly negative on gains. For Pisces lagna the own-sign placement does not rescue the result in Frawley's view.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Say income may flow to travel, charity or distant ventures and that budgeting helps. Do not repeat the 'many wives' or 'lustful' line.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of loss in the house of home and mother: BPHS, Raman and Braha see little happiness from the mother and losses around land, vehicles and houses; Raman adds living abroad and Braha a strong spiritual pull.
common_outcomes: little happiness from the mother; daily losses concerning land, vehicles and houses (BPHS 24.136)
mental restlessness, enmity of relatives and living abroad (Raman HTJH)
an ordinary residence and trouble from landlords (Raman HTJH); few fixed assets, car problems (Braha)
a strong spiritual nature: a moksha lord in a moksha house (Braha)
rare_outcomes: a well-placed 12th lord mitigates much of this (Raman HTJH)
rents out part of the home or buys houses to rent (Braha)
many career changes, as the 12th lord aspects the 10th (Braha)
with the 4th lord and benefics: substantial property and growing interest in spiritual literature (Raman HTJH, periods)

by_area.personality: Mentally restless and worried (Raman HTJH).
by_area.career: Many career changes (Braha).
by_area.finance: Losses on land, vehicles and houses (BPHS 24.136; Braha).
by_area.family: Little happiness from the mother (BPHS 24.136; Braha); enmity of relatives (Raman HTJH).
by_area.spirituality: Desire for liberation (Braha).

strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1); a well-placed 12th lord (Raman HTJH)
a strong Venus: own conveyance, though it gives trouble (Raman HTJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction of the 12th lord: trouble over property (Raman HTJH, periods)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha agree on losses and distance from the mother; Raman adds living abroad and Braha a spiritual pull.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Suggest home life may involve moves or distance from the birthplace and that property needs careful handling. No claims about the mother's health.
